title: Montageplaner (m/w/d) Versorgungstechnik (HKLS)
description: Du arbeitest gerne genau, strukturiert und praxisnah? Du kennst dich mit HKLS-Materialien, Montageabläufen und technischen Details aus und möchtest Pläne erstellen, die auf der Baustelle wirklich funktionieren? Dann bist du bei BIMEXPERTS genau richtig. Für unseren Standort in Vilshofen suchen wir einen Montageplaner (m/w/d) im Bereich Versorgungstechnik (HKLS), der Materialverständnis, eine genaue Ausarbeitung mit einer ausführungsreifen Planung verbindet. Bei uns geht es nicht nur darum, Leitungen zu zeichnen, sondern durchdachte, umsetzbare und nachvollziehbare Montageunterlagen zu erstellen. Aufgaben: Du erstellst Montagepläne und Ausführungsunterlagen im Bereich HKLS in 2D und 3D. Du arbeitest technische Vorgaben, Schemata, Grundrisse, Modelle und Planungsunterlagen in umsetzbare Montagepläne aus. Du achtest auf Leitungsführungen, Einbausituationen, Kollisionspunkte, Revisionsmöglichkeiten und eine praxisgerechte Ausführung. Du berücksichtigst Materialien, Rohrsysteme, Formstücke, Armaturen, Dämmungen, Befestigungen, Brandschutzanforderungen und bauliche Gegebenheiten. Du prüfst Planungsstände auf Plausibilität, Vollständigkeit und technische Umsetzbarkeit. Du koordinierst dich persönlich, telefonisch oder online mit Projektbeteiligten und hältst die wesentlichen Ergebnisse nachvollziehbar fest. Du dokumentierst offene Punkte, Änderungen und technische Entscheidungen nachvollziehbar, forderst notwendige Entscheidungen proaktiv ein und schaffst die Voraussetzungen, um selbstständig weiterarbeiten zu können. Du arbeitest mit CAD-/BIM-Tools und hilfst mit, unsere digitalen Planungsprozesse weiterzuentwickeln. Qualifikation: Du hast eine abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung oder mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich HKLS, Gebäudetechnik – idealerweise aus einem Installationsunternehmen, der Montage, Bauleitung oder Baustellenpraxis. Du kommst aus der Ausführung und möchtest dich stärker in Richtung Technik, Planung und Montageplanung weiterentwickeln. Du hast Erfahrung in der Montageplanung, Ausführungsplanung oder als Bauleiter im Bereich Heizung, Kälte, Lüftung und Sanitär. Du bringst ein sehr gutes Verständnis für Normen, Produkte, Materialien, Rohrsysteme, Formteile, Befestigungen, Dämmungen, Armaturen und Montageabläufe mit. Du kannst 2D Pläne lesen und Zusammenhänge verstehen und Details so ausarbeiten, dass sie ohne Rückfragen mit dem Plan auf der Baustelle baubar sind. Du denkst nicht nur zeichnerisch, sondern auch baustellen-, montage- und ausführungsorientiert. Du arbeitest genau, strukturiert, zuverlässig und mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch. Du hast idealerweise Erfahrung mit AutoCAD, Revit, Plancal Nova oder vergleichbaren CAD-/BIM-Systemen. Du verfügst über Deutschkenntnisse auf B2-Niveau in Wort und Schrift. Benefits: Anspruchsvolle HKLS-Projekte mit hoher technischer Tiefe, bei denen Genauigkeit zählt und es ausdrücklich erwünscht ist, Fehler, Unklarheiten und Verbesserungspotenziale aktiv anzusprechen. Ein Aufgabenbereich, in dem Genauigkeit, Erfahrung und Materialverständnis wirklich zählen. Moderne Arbeitsmittel, digitale Planungsprozesse und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten im Bereich BIM. Kurze Entscheidungswege und direkte Zusammenarbeit mit Projektleitung und Technik. Ein Umfeld, in dem praxisnahes Denken, saubere Ausarbeitung und technische Qualität geschätzt werden. Die Möglichkeit, Standards, Vorlagen und Arbeitsabläufe aktiv mitzuverbessern. Langfristige Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem international wachsenden Unternehmen. Noch ein paar Worte zum Schluss Wir suchen jemanden, der nicht nur Pläne erstellt, sondern technische Details versteht und Montageunterlagen so ausarbeitet, dass sie für Projektteam und Baustelle echten Nutzen bringen. Wenn du sorgfältig arbeitest, Erfahrung mit HKLS-Materialien mitbringst und Freude an klarer, strukturierter Planung hast, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung. Ein klassisches Motivationsschreiben ist nicht zwingend erforderlich. Wir freuen uns jedoch, wenn du uns einen kurzen Einblick in deine Beweggründe und deine Motivation gibst. Bewirb dich unkompliziert mit deinem Lebenslauf sowie, falls vorhanden, relevanten Projektbeispielen oder Zeugnissen. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: Transform with us the future of energy ⚡ The SGB‑SMIT Group is an international transformer manufacturer with locations in Europe, Asia and America . With reliable transformer technology, the company actively supports the global energy transition in areas such as renewable energy, industry and urban energy infrastructure. As a key link between power generation, transmission and distribution, SGB‑SMIT Group develops and manufactures power transformers, distribution transformers, cast‑resin transformers and custom solutions for data centers, industrial applications and e‑mobility. These products ensure efficient, stable and secure energy flows worldwide. With more than 3,800 employees worldwide, the SGB‑SMIT Group stands for quality, innovation and sustainability and offers a stable environment to work on technologies that shape the energy systems of the future. What sets the SGB-SMIT Group apart : 🌍 We combine the strength of an international technology company with an employee-oriented corporate culture : Meaningful work at the heart of the energy transition Short decision-making processes and direct cooperation Stable, growing company with long-term prospects Your contribution counts – both professionally and personally . Your benefits at SGB-SMIT Group: 🚀 Stable, growing company with long-term prospects Attractive salary and social benefits Flexible working hours and hybrid working models 30+1 vacation days plus special leave Training and development opportunities Company pension plan and employee insurance Health and fitness offers (HanseFit) Company restaurant, free drinks, and e-charging parking spaces Bicycle and IT leasing Subsidy for Germany/RVV ticket Employee discounts via Benify Your tasks: 📌 Manage and coordinate the Group’s periodic consolidation processes in LucaNet , including intercompany reconciliation, consolidation entries and quality reviews. Prepare monthly, quarterly and annual Group reporting and consolidated financial statements in accordance with IFRS . Act as a key contact for IFRS and Group Accounting matters , including technical assessments, accounting policies and reporting guidelines. Monitor new IFRS requirements and ensure their consistent implementation across the Group. Continuously improve Group Accounting, consolidation and reporting processes , including related systems and documentation. Collaborate with international finance teams and corporate functions and serve as a key contact for external auditors . Support cross-functional Finance projects, management reporting and selected capital-market and strategic Finance initiatives . Your profile: 🔎 University degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting or a comparable field. Several years of relevant experience in Group Accounting, consolidation, financial reporting or audit , ideally gained with a Big Four/international audit firm and/or an international company. Strong practical knowledge of IFRS and experience with consolidated financial statements. Hands-on experience with LucaNet or a comparable consolidation and reporting system. Strong analytical and project management skills with a structured, pragmatic and solution-oriented approach . Confident communicator, comfortable working with senior management, auditors and international stakeholders . High level of ownership, reliability and integrity. Very good Excel and PowerPoint skills and fluent English; German is an advantage. If you value a dynamic, growing, and intercultural environment and enjoy hands-on work, then become part of the SGB-SMIT Group - transform with us the future of energy . ⚡ We look forward to receiving your application! ⚡ Learn more about the SGB-SMIT Group as an employer, our values, and career opportunities on our careers page: https://www.sgb-smit.com/career-jobs/sgb-smit-group#/ The terms used in this text refer to all genders in accordance with the General Equal Treatment Act (AGG). . About Exa

We raised a $250M Series C to build the search engine for AIs. Led by a16z, with existing investors Benchmark, Lightspeed, and YC doubling down, the round brings Exa's valuation to $2.2 billion.

Exa is building a search engine for the AI era. Our Search API currently powers Agents, Fortune 500s, and AI labs as we transform an industry that hasn't been disrupted since the 90s. We're a largely SF-based team of ~100 from Harvard, MIT, Meta, Google Research, ex-founders, and dropouts alike.

We are rapidly building the most intelligent search engine in history. We're high agency, low-ego, and united by the feeling that this is one of the last problems worth getting right.

About the Role

Our Solutions Architects and Forward Deployed Engineers are aligned to accounts, segments and Account Executives. This role isn't. As a Principal Field Engineer, you work across the whole business: every region, every segment, presales and post-sales. Your job is to make Exa impossible to ignore for developers and technical buyers, and to make every Field Engineer better at showing what Exa can do.

You'll build the demos, workshops and on-demand training the team and our customers use everywhere, take Exa on the road to conferences, meetups and user groups, and become the go-to expert the team pulls in when a deal or a customer needs someone who knows Exa inside out. You'll spend a lot of time where developers are, and a lot of time on a plane. This is not a slideware role. You are an engineer who builds, teaches and shows.

In this role, you will:

  • Build the demos the whole team uses: flagship demos, sample apps, cookbooks and reference architectures that show Exa on real problems, and keep them current as the product ships

  • Design and deliver workshops, hands-on labs and technical webinars for prospects, customers and developer communities, and package them so any Field Engineer can run them

  • Create on-demand training content: video tutorials, self-paced courses and recorded labs that teach customers, developers and new Field Engineers how to build with Exa, without anyone in the room

  • Represent Exa at events: conference talks, booth demos, hackathons and partner events, in person, wherever the audience is

  • Start and run meetups and user groups in key cities, and grow a community of developers building with Exa

  • Be the team's subject-matter expert on Exa's products, search quality, evals and agent use cases; join key deals and customer escalations when SAs and FDEs need deeper help

  • Turn new launches into field-ready material: demos, talk tracks and competitive positioning, so the team can sell what Product ships on day one

  • Partner with Marketing on technical content, blog posts and events that generate pipeline

  • Bring what you hear back to Product: what developers try to build, where they get stuck, and what competitors are doing

Requirements

  • Several years of hands-on programming experience. You can build polished demos and sample apps from scratch, fast, and you enjoy it

  • 4+ years in a technical customer-facing role (solutions architect, sales engineer, developer advocate or similar), ideally at an AI-native, API or developer-first company

  • A track record of teaching and presenting to technical audiences: talks, workshops, webinars, video tutorials or community events

  • Strong communication skills: you can hold a room of engineers, then explain the same thing simply to an executive

  • Self-directed: you can set your own priorities without a segment or a quota to tell you where to go

  • Willingness to travel up to 50% of the time, including internationally

You might excel if you...

  • Have spoken at developer conferences, run a meetup, or built a community around a technical product

  • Have built with LLMs, RAG or agents and can talk credibly about retrieval and search quality

  • Have a following or a body of public work: open-source projects, technical blog posts, talks, videos

  • Love the moment a room full of developers sees a demo and gets it

  • Thrive in early-stage environments where your job description changes monthly

  • Care deeply about the problem of organizing the world's knowledge and making it accessible to machines

This is a remote role based in the US, with travel to events, customers and our San Francisco HQ. We're happy to sponsor international candidates (e.g., STEM OPT, OPT, H1B, O1, E3). In addition to premium healthcare benefits (medical, dental, vision), we also offer fertility benefits and a monthly wellness stipend to all of our employees.

Exa is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related conditions, criminal histories consistent with applicable law, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

Erfahrung in der Bedarfsanalyse und im Führen strukturierter Verkaufsgespräche. Erfahrung im Umgang mit CRM-Systemen (z. B. HubSpot, Pipedrive oder Salesforce). Interesse daran, AI zu nutzen , um deinen Sales-Alltag smarter, skalierbarer und wirkungsvoller zu gestalten. Deutschkenntnisse auf C1/C2-Niveau . Offenheit, regelmäßig in unser Büro in Hamburg zu kommen (hybrid). Nice-to-Haves Erfahrung im SaaS-Vertrieb . Erfahrung mit Kund:innen aus dem Handwerks- oder Baugewerbe . WARUM PLANCRAFT? Team Spirit: Mit Leidenschaft, Engagement und echtem Bock setzen wir alles daran, unsere Mission gemeinsam zu verwirklichen. Team Spirit feiern wir regelmäßig: mit 3 großen Team Events im Jahr, 2 monatlichen lockeren Formaten in unserem HQ und einer starken Recognition Culture, in der wir kleine wie große Erfolge sichtbar machen und gemeinsam zelebrieren. Ownership: Bei uns übernimmst du Verantwortung ab Tag eins. In einem Umfeld mit flachen Hierarchien und hohem Vertrauen kannst du wirklich etwas bewegen. Weiterentwicklung: Wir investieren gezielt in deine Entwicklung – durch eine starke Feedback Kultur, ein persönliches Learning Budget und Enablement Formate. Wir unterstützen jedes Team und jede einzelne Person dabei, KI im Arbeitsalltag auf dem nächsten Level einzusetzen – inklusive einer eigenen ChatGPT+-Lizenz, selbstverständlich. Tech & Tooling: Du bekommst moderne Hardware wie ein MacBook und hochwertige Over Ear Kopfhörer sowie alle Tools, die du für dein Daily Doing brauchst. Flexibilität: Ob remote, hybrid oder im Office: Du arbeitest dort, wo du es am besten kannst. Unser Hamburger Büro am Rödingsmarkt (inkl. Dachterrasse) steht dir jederzeit offen. Erholung: 30 Urlaubstage, der 24.12. frei, ein Zuschuss zum Urban Sports Club sowie interne Sport Meetups unterstützen dich beim Abschalten. Mobilität: Du kannst dir ein JobRad holen oder ein bezuschusstes Deutschlandticket bzw. eine BahnCard nutzen. Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability
 
At Hypersonica, we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast.
 
By joining Hypersonica, you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously.
 
We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.

What you'll do 

  • Own the system architecture of Hypersonica's Electronic Warfare (EW) capability, ensuring electronic support (ES), electronic attack (EA), and electronic protection (EP) functions operate as a coherent and mission-effective system. 

  • Define, maintain, and manage EW system requirements, ensuring full traceability from operational needs through system architecture, subsystem allocation, verification, and validation. 

  • Lead the development of EW system architectures, performance budgets, interface definitions, and mission integrations across airborne platforms and payloads. 

  • Conduct threat, signal, and electromagnetic environment analyses to assess system effectiveness against representative adversary capabilities and operational conditions. 

  • Lead the integration of RF sensors, receivers, transmitters, antenna systems, signal processing functions, mission computers, and platform interfaces into a coherent operational capability. 

  • Define and oversee system-level modelling, simulation, laboratory testing, ground trials, and flight trials, using evidence-based analysis to drive design improvements and risk reduction. 

  • Produce and maintain critical systems engineering artefacts including system specifications, interface control documents (ICDs), verification strategies, test plans, and design review materials. 

  • Apply model-based systems engineering (MBSE) principles to ensure traceability between requirements, architectures, analyses, verification activities, and operational outcomes. 

  • Identify and mitigate system-level risks, particularly around electromagnetic performance, interoperability, survivability, cybersecurity, verification, and platform integration. 

  • Act as the technical authority for EW system engineering, working across RF, software, hardware, mission systems, cybersecurity, safety, and platform engineering disciplines to deliver robust operational capability. 


Who you are 

  • An experienced Systems Engineer with 8+ years of experience delivering complex Electronic Warfare, RF, mission systems, avionics, aerospace, defence, or other mission-critical systems. 

  • Strong background in systems architecture, requirements development, requirements decomposition, verification, and validation throughout the engineering lifecycle. 

  • Deep understanding of Electronic Warfare concepts, including electronic support (ES), electronic attack (EA), electronic protection (EP), threat systems, and electromagnetic spectrum operations. 

  • Experience integrating RF sensors, receivers, transmitters, antennas, signal processing systems, and mission computers into operational platforms. 

  • Strong knowledge of electromagnetic environments, system performance analysis, modelling, simulation, and test methodologies. 

  • Familiar with MBSE approaches and capable of applying systems engineering rigour to complex, multidisciplinary defence programmes. 

  • Experienced supporting major design reviews, platform integration activities, flight trials, qualification programmes, and operational capability development. 

  • Technically credible across multiple disciplines, capable of influencing decisions, challenging assumptions, and driving technical direction confidently. 

  • Comfortable operating within fast-moving, high-accountability environments where ambiguity is high and execution speed matters. 

  • Motivated by solving nationally significant defence challenges and building capabilities that directly contribute to European security and technological independence. 


What we offer 

  • A mission-driven environment with the opportunity to work on one of Europe’s most consequential defence challenges, with direct impact on sovereign capability and security. 

  • Daily collaboration with top experts across engineering, operations, and defence, with real opportunity to learn from the best, contribute, and grow. 

  • High ownership and autonomy; no time tracking, no micromanagement, just clear objectives and accountability for outcomes. 

  • A fast-paced environment where good ideas are implemented quickly, and feedback from testing and operational activities drives real decisions. 

  • A culture that values clarity, integrity, and excellence, and supports people who take initiative and push boundaries responsibly. 

  • Competitive compensation and real share options aligned to responsibility and impact, not tenure or hierarchy. 


Security and Eligibility Requirement 

Due to the nature of the work done at Hypersonica, applicants must be an EU/Nato/German citizen and be eligible for Security Clearance. 

At Hypersonica, every hire raises the bar. We are deliberately small, intensely capable, and deeply mission-driven. If this role feels like a strong fit, or if you believe you bring something exceptional that goes beyond the description, we encourage you to apply.
 
Hypersonica is an equal-opportunity employer and assesses candidates solely on merit, capability, and potential.
 
You can apply directly to this role or reach out to Nathan Sweeney, Head of Talent. We review every application and aim to respond to all candidates within two weeks, whether the answer is yes or no.

title: Internships & working students at Hypersonica
description: Build what most people think is impossible. Hypersonica is building sovereign European hypersonic capability. We are developing technologies that sit at the edge of what is currently possible, and we are doing it with small, talent dense teams of exceptional people. Our culture takes inspiration from the operating philosophy behind Skunk Works. Small teams. Exceptional talent. High trust. Minimal bureaucracy. The freedom, tools and responsibility to solve problems that have not been solved before. We are looking for interns who want to work in that environment. The Opportunity This is not an internship where you spend three months shadowing someone, preparing slides or waiting to be given something meaningful to do. You will work alongside some of the best engineers and operators in Europe on real problems connected to real hardware and real programmes. Depending on your background, that could mean contributing to areas such as: Engineering, propulsion, aerodynamics, structures, materials, avionics, GNC, software, electronics, manufacturing, test, quality, simulation, data or operations. The exact problem matters less than how you approach it. You will be given responsibility early, expected to think independently and encouraged to challenge assumptions. If you see a better way of doing something, we want to hear it. Who we are looking for We are not simply looking for the highest grades. We are looking for people with exceptional potential. People who are deeply curious. People who ask why something has to be done a certain way. People who are not restricted by what they already know, what has been done before, or what others believe to be possible. You might be a great fit if: You learn extraordinarily quickly. You enjoy solving difficult problems with incomplete information. You naturally break problems down to first principles. You build things because you are curious about whether they can be built. You are comfortable being wrong, learning quickly and trying again. You care deeply about the quality of your work. You want feedback and are equally comfortable giving it. You can communicate clearly with people very different from yourself. You want responsibility rather than supervision. You would rather create something than inherit a finished system. What we value Mission alignment. Exceptional subject matter ability. The ability to execute in ambiguity. A builder mindset. A willingness to be on site, close to the hardware and the people building it. We believe in radical candour. High performing people should be able to challenge one another, give direct feedback and change their minds when the evidence demands it. We also believe that the strongest teams are built from different perspectives, backgrounds and ways of thinking. What you will get The chance to work on technology that very few people in the world ever get close to. Direct exposure to exceptional engineers and technical leaders. Real ownership. Real hardware. Real problems. A very steep learning curve. And, if you are exceptional, the opportunity to build a career with us after university. Who should apply We are interested in outstanding students from leading universities across the Germany and Europe, including Oxford, Cambridge, TUM, LMU and others, however: Your university matters less than your ability. Your degree matters less than what you can do with it. Your experience matters less than how quickly you can learn. We are particularly interested in people who can point to something they have built, researched, competed in, broken, redesigned, coded, tested or taught themselves simply because they wanted to understand whether it could be done. Security and Eligibility Requirement Due to the nature of the work we undertake, applicants must be a EU/Nato/German citizen, and be eligible for German Security Clearance. One final thing If you are looking for a comfortable internship with a clearly defined playbook, Hypersonica probably is not for you. If you want to spend your internship surrounded by exceptional people trying to build technology years ahead of where most believe it should be possible, we would like to hear from you. Come and build something that does not yet exist. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

raw.description:
Role: Senior Design Engineer

Company: Deel

Location: United Kingdom, Israel, Portugal, Spain, Czech Republic, Poland, France, Switzerland, Hungary, Ireland, Sweden, Germany or Estonia

Job Type: Full-time

About Deel

Deel is the all-in-one payroll and HR platform for global teams. HRIS, payroll, compliance, benefits, performance and equipment management sit in one product. It supports every worker type in 150+ countries. In 2024, Deel paid $11.2 billion to workers in nearly 100 currencies and provided healthcare and benefits in 109 countries.

The company has a $17.3 billion valuation and reached $1 billion in ARR in just over five years. About 7,000 people work at Deel, across more than 100 countries and 74 languages. Customers rate it 4.83 on average, from 15,000 reviews on G2, Trustpilot, Capterra, Apple and Google.

Most teams use AI as a faster way for humans to build products. Deel wants to go further and build the system that lets AI build the products. Humans set the taste, the guardrails and the standards it works within.

That system is your product. You build what AI generates against: the design system and component architecture, the generation and agent workflows, the quality gates that keep output production-ready, and the feedback loops that keep it all visible to the team. You stay hands-on as a designer, because the quickest way to prove the system works is to ship real interfaces on top of it.

This is a senior individual contributor role in Product Design. You split your time between Figma and a code editor in roughly equal measure. You work directly with design leadership to drive AI adoption across the whole design organisation, and you sit in a cross-functional team with Engineering and Product.

What you are expected to do:

Build the system

  • Architect the design system, tokens and components as the substrate AI generates against.

  • Design prompt libraries, patterns and agent workflows that turn design intent into production-ready UI with minimal human assembly.

Prove it by designing

  • Stay a practising designer. Explore concepts quickly and design real interfaces.

  • Prototype in production front-end code. You are the first and toughest test of whether the system produces excellent, shippable work.

Own quality, guardrails and evals

  • Define production-readiness criteria for AI-generated UI.

  • Set design-to-code fidelity benchmarks, regression safeguards and evaluation methods that keep AI output honest. Speed must not cost craft.

Drive the AI workflow across the design org

  • Work with design leadership to maintain, evolve and roll out the AI-native workflow across the whole design organisation, not only your own work.

  • Treat it as an ongoing responsibility. Drive adoption, keep standards current as tools change, and embed the workflow across teams so it never depends on one person.

Work across functions

  • Collaborate closely with Engineering, Product and design-system contributors. You complement engineering and do not replace it.

  • Keep the system round-tripping to shared surfaces such as Figma. AI-accelerated output stays visible and open to feedback, never a black box.

Push into generative UI

  • Take AI beyond the build process and into the product itself.

  • Prototype and evaluate adaptive, AI-generated interfaces as a product capability, and help decide where they belong on the roadmap.

Level up the team

  • Turn what works into playbooks, prompt libraries and enablement. The wider design org builds on the system and does not depend on you. The goal is durable capability, not tool dependency.

What you need to succeed:

  • You move fluidly between design and code. You don't need to be the deepest specialist in either. You can design something well, build it yourself, and use AI to move quickly between the two.

  • You have real taste for layout, typography, interaction and motion, and you care about polish.

  • You are comfortable writing TypeScript and React, including HTML, CSS and animation. You prototype fast and get from idea to working interface in hours rather than days, moving between Figma and code.

  • You have built or extended design systems that others rely on.

  • You already use AI design and coding tools in real work, and you want to help shape new ones.

  • You have 7+ years in product design and front-end engineering on complex products. You are comfortable with ambiguity, and you set standards others follow.

What you get:

  • Stock grant opportunities, depending on your role, employment status and location.

  • Additional perks and benefits based on your employment status and country.

  • Optional flexible working office membership with IWG.

description: Our Mission Aleph Alpha is one of the few companies in Europe doing serious foundation model pre-training like our recently released Kolibri-1 model . Our customers - in finance, manufacturing, public administration - need models that understand German, meet European regulatory requirements, and work reliably in high-stakes settings. We're building that in Heidelberg. Team Culture At Aleph Alpha, we foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organizational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision-making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose. We believe a strong engineering culture is the key to model training success. We like Extreme Programming and favor trunk-based development. We often mob-program, which keeps us aligned and means we always learn from each other. About the Role As a Senior AI R&D Engineer in Model Training (f/m/d), you will join our model training team in Heidelberg or Berlin. Most of the team is based in Heidelberg. The model training team is building and improving our model training pipeline, which has been used to train Kolibri. You will work across our full stack. Some weeks you might be optimizing how training loads are scheduled on our cluster and making the pipeline more robust and performant so we can iterate faster. Other weeks, you will be enabling large-scale code execution for reinforcement learning. And at other times, you might dig deep into our evaluation codebase to lift inference throughput on evals. No two days are the same. Things move fast, and your ability to focus and prioritize is what lets you unblock the team day-to-day while designing the high-quality tooling and infrastructure that speeds us up long-term. We're still building out our training pipeline and infrastructure. Some pieces exist, some do not, and you will have real influence on what gets built and how. Your work directly shapes how quickly we can experiment and improve our models. Identifying issues and taking initiative is what drives our day-to-day work. Working mode, design decisions, priorities are all done in your team together with your team mates. The strongest teams often use highly collaborative techniques, like mob or pair programming. Due to the highly collaborative nature of our work you are expected to be on-site at least two days a week. If you are in Berlin, you should expect to travel around every second month for a few days to Heidelberg. We are specifically looking to strengthen the Software Engineering in the teams which are research heavy. Major points include improving the maintainability of our code through tests and design & architecture changes. Requirements At its core, you need to be able to dive into a codebase, change the behavior as necessary, and after the change the code should be better tested and easier to understand than before. As such we look for candidates for an understanding of how to design for low coupling and high cohesion paired with the ability to incrementally refactor. Experience with the following technologies is likely to be helpful: Test Driven Development (TDD) Trunk based development Continuous integration Domain Driven Design Nice-to-haves Most of our code is in Python, there is also the occasional Rust codebase. Large parts of our training pipeline are built on top of Kubernetes. We do not hire for skills in a particular technology or language, but rather ability to learn and mindset, yet experience with these technologies is a plus. At voize, we believe the greatest gift to frontline workers is time - time to care, connect, and be present. Today, that time is lost to busywork and complex systems that pull them away from what matters most: people.

Our vision is to change that by building AI companions that seamlessly take over digital workflows. We don’t replace humans with technology - we amplify their impact.

Our mission is backed with $50M in Series A funding led by Balderton Capital, with support from HV Capital, Y Combinator, and other leading VCs. Today, 2,000+ facilities trust voize, and over 200,000 users rely on our AI companion to ease their daily workload.

As a dynamic team, we combine first-in-class technology with meaningful social impact. And now, we’re looking for you to join us on this mission!

💡 Your Mission: Be the technical partner our hospital customers trust

As Technical Account Manager - Hospital, you will own the technical relationship with a portfolio of our strategic hospital customers. You will understand their systems, infrastructure, integrations, and stakeholders, and support them from go-live through releases and renewals; ensuring voize runs reliably across wards, sites, and clinical workflows. Your success will be measured by trust, retention, and long-term customer outcomes.

🚀 Your Daily Business - No two days are alike

  • Own the technical relationship with a portfolio of hospitals and hospital groups, building a deep understanding of their HIS/KIS setup, infrastructure, clinical workflows, open topics, and key stakeholders

  • Maintain a technical account plan for every customer, covering integrations, deployment architecture, security requirements, planned changes, open risks, and upcoming rollout waves

  • Lead release pre-briefings and technical reviews, helping customers assess the impact of changes across systems before they affect clinical operations

  • Stay close to every issue across your accounts: Technical Support manages the queue, while you manage the relationship and provide the technical and organizational context needed to accelerate resolution

  • Identify recurring themes across hospital customers and turn them into actionable feedback for Product and Engineering, improving reliability, integrations, and rollout readiness

🤝 Your Skillset - What you bring to the table

  • Several years of experience in technical account management, solutions engineering, technical support, or implementation, ideally in B2B SaaS, health tech, or hospital IT

  • Hands-on technical knowledge of integrations, APIs, logs, networks, identity and access management, and device or MDM setups; familiarity with healthcare interoperability standards such as HL7 or FHIR is a plus

  • Great communication skills across technical, clinical, and executive audiences, from discussing an interface with hospital IT to aligning on a rollout with nursing leadership or senior management

  • A structured, calm approach to managing complex organizations, multiple sites, and open topics simultaneously, supported by data that demonstrates progress and impact

  • Professional German and comfortable English, based in Germany, and willingness to occasionally travel to customer sites when a rollout or escalation requires on-site support; experience with hospital information systems is a plus

🌱 Growing together - what you can expect at voize

  • We are a fast-growing startup, which means you will tackle meaningful challenges, grow quickly, and make a real impact by giving frontline workers more time for people

  • Become a co-creator of our success with stock options

  • We foster an open, collaborative culture with regular team events, whether you work from our Berlin office or remotely across Germany

  • Generous perks: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off, Germany Transport Ticket, Urban Sports Club, regular company off-sites, access to learning platforms such as Blinkist and Audible, and free language courses

  • You decide when you work best, with flexible working hours and a strong hybrid setup

✨ Ready to talk? Apply now! 🚀

We look forward to your application and can’t wait to meet you - no matter who you are or what background you have!

raw.description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

Head of Electronics & Software

Purpose

We are looking for a Head of Electronics & Software to lead and develop the engineering capability behind some of the most critical systems in our spacecraft.

This is a senior leadership role combining people leadership, engineering excellence, organisational development and technical breadth. You will lead a multidisciplinary organisation spanning:

  • Avionics, communications and electrical power systems

  • Flight software (FSW)

  • Guidance, navigation and control (GNC)

  • Electrical wiring and interconnection systems (EWIS), including harness engineering

  • Future projects and advanced electronics and software development

You will be responsible for ensuring our teams have the people, skills, processes, tools and engineering standards needed to deliver ambitious space programmes today, while building the capabilities we will need for the future.

This is not a role for someone looking to step away from engineering. We are looking for a leader who can engage credibly with highly technical teams, challenge constructively, develop strong technical leaders and help create an environment where exceptional engineering can happen.

Matrix Organisation

Our engineering teams work in a matrix organisation, combining strong functional leadership with project-based delivery.

As Head of Electronics & Software, you will lead the functional organisation, developing its people and capabilities while working closely with Project Managers, Project Chief Engineers, technical authorities and engineering Leads responsible for programme delivery.

You will:

  • Lead and develop Project Leads, discipline Leads, Principal Engineers and transversal engineering resources

  • Partner with project leadership to align capability, resources and priorities with programme needs

  • Help teams navigate competing priorities across projects

  • Ensure clear ownership and accountability between functional leadership and project execution

  • Build an organisation capable of supporting multiple programmes as the company grows

Success in this environment requires collaboration, influence and sound engineering judgement rather than centralising every technical decision.

Role Boundaries

This role owns the strength and effectiveness of the Electronics & Software organisation: its people, capability, engineering practices, tools, standards and functional budget.

You will create the environment in which our technical teams can perform at their best, providing mentoring, challenge and access to expertise while supporting technical and project leadership in making strong engineering decisions.

Project technical decisions and product technical authority remain within the relevant project and technical organisations. Your role is to ensure they are supported by a highly capable engineering organisation with the right expertise, methods and resources.

Key Responsibilities

People, Hiring & Organisation

You will build and shape a high-performing Electronics & Software organisation.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Owning workforce and headcount planning across the function

  • Recruiting and retaining exceptional engineering talent

  • Developing clear job families, role levels and assessment standards

  • Partnering with Talent Acquisition, engineering Leads and hiring managers to maintain a high technical hiring bar

  • Leading promotion, compensation and organisational planning within the function

  • Building succession plans and reducing key-person dependencies in specialist areas

  • Creating an organisation that remains lean, scalable and aligned with current and future programme needs

Line Management & Development

Developing strong engineers and technical leaders will be a major part of the role.

You will:

  • Lead and develop the managers, Leads and senior engineers within your organisation

  • Establish meaningful objectives aligned with project and company priorities

  • Build clear development and technical career paths

  • Strengthen mentoring, coaching and leadership capability across the organisation

  • Create opportunities for engineers to gain experience across design, integration, test and operations

  • Address performance challenges fairly and constructively

  • Build a culture where progression is based on demonstrated capability, impact and organisational need

Engineering Processes, Standards & Compliance

You will help define how excellent electronics and software engineering is done across the company.

This includes:

  • Owning and continuously improving engineering practices across electronics, software, GNC and electrical/harness engineering

  • Establishing practical standards for electronics design, software development, testing, modelling, reviews and verification

  • Ensuring teams understand and can effectively apply the relevant processes

  • Supporting certification readiness, audits and continuous improvement, including applicable EN9100 requirements

  • Working closely with Quality, Safety, Systems Engineering and the Chief Engineer organisation

  • Using lessons from development, testing and operations to continuously improve engineering practices

Our aim is not process for process's sake. We want processes that are lean, pragmatic and proportionate to engineering risk.

Engineering Tools & Ways of Working

You will ensure our engineers have the tools and engineering environment needed to work effectively and at scale.

This includes capability across:

  • Electronics and PCB design

  • Harness CAD

  • Software development, build and configuration toolchains

  • Automated testing

  • GNC analysis and modelling

  • Software-in-the-loop and hardware-in-the-loop environments

  • Simulation and shared test infrastructure

You will drive standardisation, adoption and good engineering practice while partnering with Digital, IT, Procurement, Quality and other engineering teams.

The goal is simple: engineering work should be efficient, traceable, reproducible and ready to scale.

Project Support & Resource Planning

You will work closely with our projects to ensure they have access to the Electronics & Software capability they need.

You will:

  • Mentor engineering Leads and provide senior technical guidance where needed

  • Support major technical and engineering reviews

  • Maintain visibility of capability gaps, resource constraints and significant engineering risks

  • Work with project leadership to resolve resource requirements through hiring, development, internal mobility or external support

  • Anticipate future capacity constraints before they become programme blockers

  • Help resolve cross-project resource and organisational conflicts

  • Contribute to the company-wide electronics and software strategy alongside the Chief of Engineering and CTO

  • Shape future capabilities, reusable technologies, R&D priorities and obsolescence strategies

Budget

You will own the Electronics & Software functional budget and forecast, including:

  • Headcount and personnel planning

  • Engineering tools and licences

  • Relevant shared simulation and test capability

  • Training and development

  • Functional team travel

You will work closely with Finance, Procurement, Digital and project leadership to ensure investment supports both immediate programme needs and longer-term engineering capability.

Requirements

We are looking for someone who combines credible engineering depth with proven organisational leadership.

You should bring:

  • Strong hands-on engineering experience in at least one of the following: avionics, electronics, embedded systems, flight software, GNC or electrical systems

  • Enough technical breadth to operate effectively across several of these disciplines and understand how they interact

  • Experience leading multidisciplinary engineering teams in a complex product environment

  • Proven formal line-management experience, including developing managers and technical leaders

  • Experience hiring, developing and building engineering organisations

  • Experience with organisational design, workforce and capacity planning

  • Experience creating or improving engineering processes, tools, standards and ways of working

  • Experience operating within a matrix organisation and supporting multiple projects or programmes

  • Strong coaching, mentoring, communication and influencing skills

  • The technical credibility to challenge senior engineers while empowering the appropriate technical owners to make decisions

  • A pragmatic approach to engineering quality, assurance and compliance, including relevant EN9100 practices

Experience in spacecraft, launch vehicles, aerospace, defence, aviation, robotics or another complex safety-critical engineering environment would be particularly relevant.

We are looking for a leader who:

  • Leads with high standards, humility and low ego

  • Enjoys developing people rather than simply directing them

  • Empowers strong technical Leads and avoids becoming a bottleneck

  • Can challenge experienced engineers constructively

  • Makes decisions using data and sound engineering judgement

  • Balances immediate programme pressures with long-term organisational capability

  • Creates clarity where responsibilities cross organisational boundaries

  • Promotes transparency, accountability, collaboration and continuous learning

  • Believes in extreme ownership and engineering first principles

  • Remains close enough to the engineering to understand the challenges our teams are solving

Location & Travel

This is a leadership role with teams and stakeholders across our European organisation, so regular face-to-face engagement is important.

You should expect to spend time across our main European sites, with additional travel where required for team leadership, recruitment, major engineering reviews, audits and project support.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?

We want you as a talented AIT MGSE Engineer to help us in our mission by designing and delivering the MGSEs needed for the preparation of our next capsule.

Key Responsibilities

In your capacity as MAIT MGSE Engineer, your role will be continuously evolving, but day to day duties will include:

  • Work closely with Engineering and AIT colleagues to understand and refine the requirements/timelines for the different MGSEs that we will need for various assembly or testing activities.

  • Conceptualise, design (CAD including manufacturing drawings), procure and commission the MGSEs.

  • Confirm with mechanical analysis/hand calculations/proof tests that the design is compatible with the external loads.

  • Discuss with suppliers the MGSE designs for ease of manufacturing and with the most adequate processes.

  • Follow up the manufacturing/procurement with the suppliers (with the support of our supply chain team) and answer any technical questions/concerns ensuring timely delivery of all items.

  • Provide necessary instructions and support the assembly/commissioning/ implementation of these MGSEs.

What we would love to see from you

In the role of MAIT MGSE Engineer ideally, you will have the following:

  • Mechanical / Aerospace engineering degree or similar with focus on machine / structural design.

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in CAD design + drafting (using Siemens NX or similar) and FE analysis (using Hypermesh or similar).

  • Good understanding of machine design and different manufacturing processes (e.g. machining, welding, etc), design for manufacturing and GD&T.

  • Familiarity with standard margin calculation methodologies for various applications like beams, bolted joints, welds, etc.

  • Experience with design of test setups/jigs/fixtures and planning/execution of mechanical tests in-house would be a plus.

  • Good at documentation including design descriptions, assembly instructions, test reports, etc.

  • Creative with innovative ideas and technical problem solving/troubleshooting skills.

  • Basic hands-on experience with mechanical assembly and simple machining tools like drilling machine.

  • Previous experience in space AIT and MGSE design would be highly appreciated.

  • Good English communication skills (German would be a plus).

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 
The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable.  


All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which will be subject to the country, role, and project you applied for. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree that any offer of employment may be conditional upon successful condition of this check. The Exploration Company partners with Zinc Work Limited located in the UK (Zinc), a third-party provider, to ensure this process as efficient and transparent as possible.

If applicable, you will receive an email from Zinc upon acceptance of your offer with a link to a secure portal where you can provide the required information to Zinc.

Hi there! We're hiring an Enterprise Account Executive GCC to join our Sales team in UAE.

Our sales team is tenured, technically curious, and genuinely invested in doing right by the customer. We partner closely across the business, and we operate with a lot of trust: you're given real ownership over your territory, and you're expected to bring your own judgment to how you build it.

This role gives you a book of enterprise accounts to grow and a real say in how you build your territory. You'll work complex, multi-stakeholder deals, and you'll have the backing of sales engineering and customer success behind you as you build credibility and close.

As an Enterprise Account Executive II, you'll own the full sales cycle for a defined set of enterprise accounts, from first conversation through negotiation and close, partnering with sales engineering, customer success, and your manager to navigate complex deals. This role matters because enterprise wins are how Camunda grows its footprint in large accounts, and how we prove the platform works at scale.

What You Will Do

  • Build a territory plan that identifies land opportunities and expand possibilities, leveraging extended resources like partners, marketing, and customer success.

  • Build account plans that identify whitespace, map stakeholders, and set a realistic path to close.

  • Navigate multi-stakeholder buying committees, including technical, business, and economic buyers.

  • Own and execute the full sales cycle, from prospecting through negotiation and close.

  • Partner with sales engineering and customer success to build technical credibility and ensure a smooth handoff and adoption after close.

  • Manage pipeline and forecast with discipline and accuracy.

What You Will Bring to the Role

  • Must have proven product sales experience in Oman, Qatar

  • Must have proven experience in outbound sales and pipeline generation.

  • Solid experience closing enterprise software deals end-to-end, with a track record across multiple full sales cycles. You know what it takes to move a deal from first meeting to signature without losing momentum.

  • Comfort navigating multi-stakeholder enterprise environments. You've worked complex deals involving IT, business, and procurement stakeholders, and you know how to keep everyone moving in the same direction.

  • Developing territory and account planning instincts, with the ability to orchestrate resources efficiently. You can build a plan with some independence, not just work from a list handed to you.

  • Comfort selling technical products. Experience with process automation, integration platforms, middleware, or similar technical software is a real advantage, since you'll regularly be in the room with engineering and IT buyers.

  • Ability and/or willingness to use our product.

Compensation

We offer competitive, fair, and transparent compensation. Salary ranges are location-based, with Standard and Major markets (global tech hubs) reflecting local competition.

We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.

  • Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.

  • In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets, including contributing to meetups while travelling,, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi.

The Live Well program launches in 2026 and scales to €1,000 annually from 2027.

  • Financial Security: Retirement and pension plans (often with company contributions), plus life and disability insurance where relevant.

  • Professional Growth: Up to $/€/£1,000 per year for self-driven learning: courses, certifications, books, you decide!

At Camunda, we honour diverse cultures and backgrounds and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, religion, belief, sexual orientation, age, disability or any other protected characteristics under applicable law. We are looking forward to your application!

Come join us and be part of Camunda’s incredible journey: Make an impact at a pivotal moment in our story!

Camunda will only contact candidates from an email address ending in @camunda.com or @talent.camunda.com. If you receive a suspicious message, please do not respond, click any links, or share personal information.

description: <p><strong>The Team:</strong></p> <p>We are Datadog's in-house product experts. The technical solutions team enables Datadog's worldwide growth by educating potential clients and ensuring that existing customers are happy and successful. We share our technical and product expertise with customers through demos, presentations, technical evaluations, and ongoing support. Technical solutions is a growing global team that collaborates constantly to share knowledge and continuously advance our technical skillset.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>The Opportunity: </strong></p> <p>The Partner Solution Architect (PSA) is a Datadog expert who will work closely with Datadog’s Director, Adoption Services, and is aligned to our Channels &amp; Alliances business segment. The PSA is responsible for supporting a variety of technical initiatives and activities for our partners (for example: cloud migration, application modernization, DevOps transformation). They are accountable for the outcome of these initiatives, and frequently collaborate with both Datadog and Partner resources to drive success. The PSA is a trusted technical advisor for our Partner channel.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>You Will:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ensure the successful onboarding, training, enablement, and certification of partner technical resources;</li> <li>Participate in periodic joint business planning and review sessions to ensure direct alignment between Datadog and Partner technical teams;</li> <li>Collaborate internally to support Partner technical initiatives such as end-customer demonstrations and proofs of value; partner team enablement workshops; assessment, advice, and coaching on lead practices;</li> <li>Advocate on behalf of Partners’ technical concerns (use cases, feature requests, support issues, e.g.) with Datadog internal teams and personnel, helping to bring those concerns to resolution;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Analyze and understand Partner service offerings on a regular basis and provide recommendations to enhance the value of those services through greater or improved adoption of Datadog features and capabilities;</li> <li>Collaborate with Datadog’s product management, engineering and technical services teams to help identify and prioritize new features and capabilities;</li> <li>Continuously help curate and evolve lead/best practices for Datadog platform adoption and success.</li> </ul> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <p><strong>You Are:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Possess a solid technical grounding with hands-on experience of IT Development and/or Operations;</li> <li>A demonstrable track-record and never-ending passion for learning;</li> <li>A self-starter, tech-savvy professional with solid business acumen; ability to articulate Datadog value from server room to boardroom;</li> <li>Confident presentation skills;</li> <li>Must be a current EU resident</li> <li>Desired hands-on experience in two or more of the following areas: <ul> <li>Observability: Datadog, Splunk, AppD, New Relic or Dynatrace</li> <li>Public Cloud: AWS, Azure, GCP, or Alibaba</li> <li>Containerization: Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, Cloud Foundry</li> <li>Dev/Scripting: Python, Javascript, Ruby, Perl, PHP, Go</li> <li>Config Mgmt: Terraform, Ansible, Puppet, Chef</li> <li>CI / CD: Jenkins, Gitlab</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Bonus Points:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Previous experience working in a technical role for or supporting channel partners (Systems Integrators, Managed Services Providers, e.g.);</li> <li>Previous experience using Datadog and/or other cloud monitoring tools (APM, Infrastructure, Logs, Synthetics, NPM);</li> <li>Previous experience with root-cause-analysis, troubleshooting, debugging</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Why You Should Apply:</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Generous and competitive <a href="https://www.datadoghq.com/global-benefits/" target="_blank">global</a> and <a href="https://www.datadoghq.com/us-benefits/" target="_blank">US benefits</a></li> <li>New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan</li> <li>Continuous career development and pathing opportunities&nbsp;</li> <li>Product training to develop an in-depth understanding of our product and space</li> <li>Best in breed onboarding</li> <li>Internal mentor and buddy program cross-departmentally</li> <li>Friendly and inclusive workplace culture</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About Datadog:</strong></p> <p>Datadog is the monitoring and security platform for cloud applications. Our SaaS product is used by organizations of all sizes across a wide range of industries to enable digital transformation, cloud migration, and infrastructure monitoring of our customers’ entire technology stack, allowing for seamless collaboration and problem-solving among Dev, Ops and Security teams globally. Given the resilience of cloud technologies and importance placed today in digital operations and agility, Datadog continues to innovate and is well positioned for the long term.</p> <p style="color: white;">#LI-Remote</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>About Datadog:&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Ledgy, we’re on a mission to make Europe a powerhouse of entrepreneurship by building a modern, tech-driven equity management and financial reporting platform for private and public companies. In 2026, we aim to be the leading provider for European IPOs and reporting for share-based payments. We are a value-based company with a core focus on being humble, transparent, ambitious and impactful, all in order to delivery the best experience for our customers and end users.</p> <p>We are proud to partner with some of the world’s leading investors. New Enterprise Associates led our&nbsp;<a href="https://techcrunch.com/2022/09/21/ledgy-a-carta-for-european-startups-to-manage-equity-and-cap-tables-raises-22m-from-nea-sequoia-and-more/">$22m Series B</a> round in 2022, with Philip Chopin joining Sequoia’s Luciana Lixandru on our board.</p> <p>We were founded in Switzerland in 2017 and today we operate globally from offices in Zurich and London. We encourage diversity and are an international team coming from 26 different countries and speaking 25 different languages.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><p>&nbsp;</p> <h2 id="about-the-role">About the Role</h2> <p>As a Senior DevOps Engineer at Ledgy, you'll build the infrastructure and tooling that help our engineers ship quickly and reliably. You'll join our Platform team, collaborating with engineers and InfoSec to improve CI/CD, observability, and cloud infrastructure for a product that helps companies manage equity.</p> <p>Our challenge is to make delivery faster, production easier to operate, and AI-assisted development safer - while keeping complexity and costs in check.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> We hire remotely across Spain, Germany, Poland, and Romania.</p> <p><strong>The team you'll join:</strong> Platform - Builds the infrastructure and tooling that help our engineers ship quickly and reliably, working with InfoSec to improve CI/CD, observability, and cloud infrastructure.</p> <h2 id="what-youll-work-on">What You'll Work On</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Cloud infrastructure.</strong> Evolve our GCP and Kubernetes cloud architecture and setup with Terraform, improving reliability, simplicity, and cost visibility and enabling scaling to multiple availability regions.</li> <li><strong>CI/CD and developer experience.</strong> Speed up feedback loops, reduce flaky builds, and turn recurring support requests into self-service tooling.</li> <li><strong>Observability.</strong> Reduce alert noise, define meaningful SLOs, and make production issues easier to diagnose.</li> <li><strong>Security and automation.</strong> Partner with InfoSec on secure delivery, access controls, and guardrails for AI-assisted workflows.</li> </ul> <p>You'll also join our incident-response on-call rotation during working hours and help prevent recurring issues. As we expand our servicing of public companies and jurisdictions, this on-call might evolve to compensated 24h/7 hour rotation.</p> <h2 id="youll-thrive-in-this-role-if-you">You'll Thrive in This Role If You</h2> <p>Don't worry if you don't tick every box. These are the things that would make you an especially good fit.</p> <ul> <li>Have strong DevOps / SRE background designing and operating cloud infrastructure and production systems</li> <li>Have worked with Kubernetes and infrastructure as code, ideally GCP and Terraform</li> <li>Enjoy building fast, reliable CI/CD pipelines and improving developer experience</li> <li>Can diagnose issues across networking, infrastructure, and application code</li> <li>Write maintainable code and bring a practical approach to observability and security</li> <li>Value collaboration, mentorship, and thoughtful trade-offs between reliability, complexity, and cost</li> <li>Are curious about supporting AI-assisted development safely - no AI specialism required</li> </ul> <p>Experience with Node.js, MongoDB or Temporal is a plus.</p> <h2 id="our-tech-stack">Our Tech Stack</h2> <p>We work in TypeScript: React, Tailwind CSS, and tRPC on the front end, and tRPC, Node.js, MongoDB, and Temporal on the back end. Infrastructure runs on GCP, Terraform Cloud, Kubernetes, Docker, and GitHub Actions. For observability and incident response we use Grafana, Sentry, and PagerDuty.</p> <p>You don't need to know all of it. We don't expect proficiency in every part of this stack. Strong infrastructure fundamentals and the ability to learn matter more than knowing every tool already.</p> <h2 id="what-your-journey-could-look-like">What Your Journey Could Look Like</h2> <p><strong>First 30 days:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Get to know Ledgy, the Platform team, and our internal users with an onboarding buddy</li> <li>Explore our infrastructure and delivery workflows, and ship your first improvement</li> <li>Analyze current state of our cloud infrastructure and propose meaningful enhancements</li> </ul> <p><strong>First 3 months:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Independently deliver improvements to CI/CD, observability, or infrastructure design</li> <li>Share operational ownership and help reduce recurring friction for engineers</li> <li>Contribute to architecture discussions and document what others need to operate our systems</li> </ul> <p><strong>First 6-12 months:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own DevOps and SRE function and DevOps initiatives from problem definition through rollout and adoption</li> <li>Deliver measurable improvements to developer experience, reliability, or cost</li> <li>Help shape our platform's direction and mentor other engineers</li> </ul> <h2 id="the-interview-process">The interview process</h2> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li><strong>Getting to know you (45 min):</strong> Meet with someone from our people team to talk about your experience and to ask questions about the role</li> <li><strong>Live Coding (60 min):</strong> An equity domain problem to solve collaboratively using your preferred language and IDE. We want to see how you think, so this step does not allow AI. But you can freely look up syntax questions if you need to.</li> <li><strong>System Design (60 min):</strong> A system design session where you will design an architecture for a problem from the Ledgy domain using a visual tool of your choice</li> <li><strong>DDSA (45 min):</strong> A Deep Dive into real System Architecture that you have built, owned and monitored.</li> <li><strong>Culture Interview:</strong> A chance to meet one of our founders and your hiring manager for a 30-minute chat about Ledgy's mission and values</li> <li><strong>Offer</strong> 🎉</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2 id="being-part-of-ledgy-means">Being part of Ledgy means</h2> <ul> <li>Recharge and re-energize with flexible working hours, 25 days of vacation, and up to 40 days of remote work from outside your home country.</li> <li>We make space for your own professional development, with a generous yearly learning &amp; development budget.</li> <li>This role will receive a competitive salary + benefits + equity. All salaries are aligned with competitively benchmarked ranges based on work location and levelling.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

<li>Design solutions appropriate for regulated UK environments, including financial services and telecommunications, with strong consideration of data sovereignty, privacy, security, responsible AI measures.</li> <li>Strong understanding of AI governance and safeguards, including guardrails, red-teaming, observability, responsible AI and secure deployment practices.</li> <li>Significant experience deploying AI systems on major cloud platforms using containers, orchestration and production-grade infrastructure patterns.</li> <li>Experience with model adaptation and optimisation techniques, including prompt/context engineering, fine-tuning where appropriate, and application-level performance optimisation.</li> <li>Ability to make sound architecture trade-offs across model capability, reliability, security, compliance, performance and cost.</li> </ul> </div> <h3 id="professional-skills">Professional Skills</h3> <div class="skills inner-content"> <ul> <li>Proven ability community.</li> </ul> </div> </div> <h2 id="important-things">Other things to know</h2> <div class="important-things content"> <h3>Learning &amp; Development</h3> <div class="inner-content"> <p>There title: Tech Lead - New Customers Team
description: Tech Lead - New Customers Team Hybrid in London, UK We’re looking for a Tech Lead You'll lead the engineering behind how new businesses become iwoca customers – the application they fill in, the checks they go through, and the offer they get. The company Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are. That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed. We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive. The team The New Customers team owns everything from a business's first application to a funded loan: the application flow, the logic that routes each application, the documents we ask customers for, and the models that set loan amounts and pricing. Its measure of success is the customer lifetime value it adds between sign-up and first loan. The team sets its own goals and direction. It brings together engineers, data scientists, and product and strategy people. It partners closely with credit risk on the trade-offs behind every lending decision. Knowledge sharing is central to how the team works, supported by regular forums to share findings, and dedicated research and development time. You'll lead two engineers and report to the head of engineering for iwoca's customer journey, from first application to repeat lending. The role As the Tech Lead, you'll spend most of your time building. The team is moving its offer logic out of a legacy monolith into a new service. It's the biggest change in a decade to the system behind iwoca's lending decisions. The next phase is yours to lead. Autonomy and ownership. You'll shape what the team builds, decide how to build it, and own what goes live. You'll set its engineering roadmap, including what to pull out of the monolith, what to rewrite, and in what order. Technical complexity. You'll design the team's part of the new service, which turns models and rules into a lending decision and optimises each offer across amount, duration, fee, and interest rate. You'll keep it reliable in production, easy to change as the models evolve, and able to show how it reached each decision. Experimentation and learning. You'll build the systems that let data scientists test new models on live applications. Some experiments run for years, until each loan reaches the end of its term. You'll see the long-term results of the team's lending decisions. Influence. You'll get colleagues across iwoca behind technical work that competes with new features for time. Leadership and growth. You'll line-manage and coach the team's engineers, setting context and helping them own projects end to end. As the team grows, you'll decide the skills and make-up it needs, and hire the engineers to match. The requirements Essential: Technical leadership . You've led a team of engineers for at least two years, including line management, while still remaining hands on. Backend engineering. You have deep expertise in at least one object-oriented language. You've designed, built, and run customer-facing backend systems in production. Commercial or product thinking. You take a business goal, get to the root of what's needed and why, and turn it into a technical plan. You can explain a trade-off in terms of what it means for customers and the business. AI leverage. You've built agentic workflows, or used AI to deliver engineering work you couldn't have done alone. You help your team do the same. You judge where it's useful. You check its output before it reaches production. Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience. Bonus: Lending or payments experience. You've worked in lending, payments, or another domain where engineering decisions carry financial risk. Experimentation. You've built systems that run controlled experiments, especially long-running ones. Legacy migration. You've moved business-critical logic out of a complex legacy monolith and kept everything that depends on it working. Working with data scientists. You've worked with data scientists from prototype to production, and know their work well enough to challenge it. Python stack. You've worked with Python, Django, and PostgreSQL. Frontend. You've built frontend features as well as backend services. The salary We expect to pay from £100,000 to £130,000 for this role. But, we're open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews. The culture At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective. We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them. The offices We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work: Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks. Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions. The benefits Flexible working hours. Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership. A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents. 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave. A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years. Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support. 3% Pension contributions on total earnings. An employee equity incentive scheme. Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money. Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme. Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield. And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer: A learning and development budget for everyone. Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers. Access to learning platforms like Treehouse. raw.description:
