At Hypersonica, we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast.
 
By joining Hypersonica, you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously.
 
We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.

What you'll do

  • Own the system architecture and system model for Hypersonica’s high‑speed flight vehicles, ensuring mission intent, vehicle dynamics, avionics, and GNC form a coherent, verifiable whole. 

  • Lead aerospace systems architecture design, taking responsibility for how the vehicle is defined across disciplines from early concept through Preliminary Design Review (PDR) and beyond. 

  • Build and maintain the authoritative system requirements model, decomposing mission‑level objectives into clear, testable system and sub‑system requirements. 

  • Define and own the end‑to‑end system V‑model, including requirements validation, verification strategy, and clear readiness gates for Kick‑off and PDR. 

  • Apply model‑based systems engineering (MBSE) as a practical engineering tool, not a documentation exercise, ensuring traceability between requirements, models, analyses, and tests. 

  • Develop and deliver a 6‑DoF Guidance, Navigation, and Control (GNC) model to PDR standard, in close collaboration with flight physics and avionics engineers. 

  • Apply closed‑loop control theory in the context of high‑speed flight and military guidance, ensuring controllability, stability, and performance are understood at the system level. 

  • Integrate vehicle dynamics, control laws, sensors, and actuators into a coherent closed‑loop system representation. 

  • Identify system‑level risks early particularly around requirements gaps, controllability, observability, and verification — and drive mitigations decisively. 

  • Act as a technical authority across disciplines, keeping architectural decisions coherent as designs evolve at pace. 


Who you are

  • An experienced Systems Engineer with a strong track record in system architecture, requirements decomposition, and delivery in safety‑ or mission‑critical environments. 

  • Deeply fluent in model‑based systems engineering, with practical experience owning requirements models and using MBSE to drive real engineering decisions. 

  • Strong grounding in closed‑loop control theory, applied to high‑speed flight, guidance, and defence or military systems. 

  • Comfortable developing and working with 6‑DoF flight and GNC models, and understanding their implications at vehicle level. 

  • Experienced taking systems through early design gates (Kick‑off, PDR), not just theoretical or paper studies. 

  • Someone who thinks in system behaviours, interfaces, and failure modes, not isolated components. 

  • Confident operating in ambiguous, fast‑moving environments where decisions must be made with incomplete data. 

  • Technically credible across disciplines, able to challenge assumptions and close decisions without consensus theatre. 

  • Motivated by working on systems where performance, robustness, and national‑level impact genuinely matter. 


What we offer

  • A mission driven environment with the opportunity to work on one of Europe’s most consequential defence challenges, with direct impact on sovereign capability and security. 

  • Daily collaboration with top experts across engineering, operations, and defence, with real opportunity to learn from the best, contribute, and grow. 

  • High ownership and autonomy; no time tracking, no micromanagement, just clear objectives and accountability for outcomes. 

  • A fast paced environment where good ideas are implemented quickly, and feedback from test and flight drives real decisions. 

  • A culture that values clarity, integrity, and excellence, and supports people who take initiative and push boundaries responsibly. 

  • Competitive compensation and real share options aligned to responsibility and impact, not tenure or hierarchy. 


Security and Elgibility Requirement
Due to the nature of the work with the UK MOD, applicants must be a British Citizen (or Dual UK national with British citizenship) and eligible for UK Security Clearance (SC) and, where required, Developed Vetting (DV) 
At Hypersonica, every hire raises the bar. We are deliberately small, intensely capable, and deeply mission-driven. If this role feels like a strong fit, or if you believe you bring something exceptional that goes beyond the description, we encourage you to apply.
 
Hypersonica is an equal-opportunity employer and assesses candidates solely on merit, capability, and potential.
 
You can apply directly to this role or reach out to Nathan Sweeney, Head of Talent. We review every application and aim to respond to all candidates within two weeks, whether the answer is yes or no.

About the Company
 
e.l.f. Beauty's purpose is to make the world a better place for every eye, lip, and face. 
 
Our deep commitment to clean, cruelty free beauty at an incredible value has fueled the success of our flagship brand e.l.f. Cosmetics since 2004 and driven our portfolio expansion. Today, our multi-brand portfolio includes e.l.f. Cosmetics, e.l.f. SKIN, e.l.f. Hair, Well People, Naturium and rhode.
 
In our Fiscal year 26, we had net sales of $1.6 Billion and our business performance has been nothing short of extraordinary with 7 consecutive years of net sales growth. This consistent, category-leading growth is a testament to the strength of our team, strategy, and portfolio of brands. 
 
Our total compensation philosophy offers every full-time new hire competitive pay and benefits, bonus eligibility (paid at 200% of target over the last seven fiscal years), equity, flexible time off, year-round half-day Fridays, and a hybrid 3 day in office, 2 day at home work environment. We believe the combination of our unique culture, total compensation, workplace flexibility and care for the team is unmatched across not just beauty but any industry. 
 
Visit our Career Page to learn more about our team: https://www.elfbeauty.com/work-with-us

The Senior Manager, International Customer Supply Chain will play a key role in delivering an exceptional customer and retail partner experience across rhode’s growing international business. This role will partner closely with Sales, Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Finance, Operations, international distributors and retail partners to ensure strong execution across order management, inventory flow, launch planning, and ongoing customer supply chain performance. This role will support multiple international markets and distribution partners, requiring strong coordination across regions and global supply chain processes.

This is a highly cross-functional role that requires strong analytical skills, clear communication, and the ability to operate in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where processes are still being built. The ideal candidate is proactive, solutions-oriented, and comfortable moving between day-to-day execution and longer-term process improvement.

A core focus of this role will be building strong relationships with key retail partners, understanding their supply chain requirements, supporting innovation and promotional planning, identifying and mitigating supply risks, and using customer data to improve in-stocks, fulfillment, and overall service levels.


What You'll Do

  • Serve as a key point of contact between rhode and international distributors and retail customer operations teams, supporting day-to-day execution and market-specific supply chain needs

  •  Continually assess opportunities to improve customer supply chain, reduce operational costs, and drive volume through supply chain metrics

  • Develop a deep understanding of each international distributor and retail partner’s distribution model, operational requirements, key metrics, and inventory planning needs

  • Strong analytical skills to produce qualitative/quantitative data (using Excel, PowerPoint, NetSuite, Tableau) that can be shared to drive business

  • Broad understanding of policies, processes and systems relating to retail distributor operations

  • Overseeing and ensuring smooth order processing and timely delivery across international customers, distributors, and retail partners with focus on Innovation planning and customer expansion

  • Provide weekly sell in data vs. forecast and any risks associated to the month/quarter plan to Finance, Sales and Operations stakeholders

  • Track & monitor weekly sell out data coupled with retailer in stock levels in partnership with Demand planning and Sales account leads

  • As needed, partner with international distributors, retailer Supply Chain & planning teams to drive additional orders or forecast adjustments guaranteeing appropriate inventory coverage

  • Track and report on key international customer supply chain KPIs, including fulfillment, in-stocks, service levels, on-time delivery, and potential chargeback risk

  • Internal and external collaboration for alignment and identifying opportunities

  • Participate and contribute to customer demand forecasting, maximizing forecast accuracy

  • Participate and influence assortment decisions aimed at optimizing sales and productivity by utilizing analytics, market research, consumer research, and customer intelligence

  • Partner closely with international teams, distributors, and cross-functional stakeholders to support new market launches, regional assortment expansion, and ongoing operational excellence.

  • Ability to connect internal functions to drive supply chain improvements (fill rate, on-time, in-stocks, reduce potential chargebacks, customer program execution) for the customer

  • Help educate and align internal teams on international customer expectations, distributor requirements, regional retailer requirements, and best practices for execution


    • What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain or another analytical field preferred or equivalent experience

  • 5+ years of experience in customer supply chain, retail operations, customer logistics, demand planning, supply planning, or related operational roles

  • Must have experience with Sephora and/or other global prestige beauty retailers

  • Experience supporting international retailers, distributors, or global customer supply chain operations.

  • Strong communication skills both verbal and written

  • Excellent Excel Skills and knowledge

  • Proven ability to build strong relationships with retail partners, internal cross-functional teams and deliver results

  • Ability to make thoughtful decisions when data is limited, ambiguous, or evolving

  • Experience managing multiple countries, distributors, or regional supply chain requirements 

  • Willingness to travel internationally is required


    • Other Details for Consideration
  • Location of Position: United Kingdom and European Union 
  • Travel Expectation: Must be willing to travel internationally for the business and to our HQ when needed
  • Budgeted Salary: £67,000 - £82,000 
    • The base salary range for this role is listed above. 
     
    Total compensation includes base salary, annual company-based performance bonus, and equity. Under e.l.f.’s annual bonus program, employees are eligible to earn up to 200% of their target bonus when company performance exceeds defined goals. In addition, e.l.f. provides a variety of other benefits to employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a retirement savings plan, gender neutral parental leave, and unlimited paid time off. The amount of total compensation (including base salary) offered will be based on a wide range of factors, including geographic location, experience, specific skills, and qualifications.
     
    Compensation components are subject to change at the company’s discretion
     
    This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed in this position. It also reflects the general details considered necessary to describe the principal functions of the job identified, and shall not be considered, as detailed description of all the work required inherent in the job. It is not an exhaustive list of responsibilities, and it is subject to changes and exceptions at the supervisors’ discretion.

title: Pullup Entertainment - Cdi - Responsable Comptable Generale (H/F/Nb)
description: Chez PulluP Entertainment, nous avons pour but d’offrir aux joueurs du monde entier des expériences uniques. Notre ligne éditoriale se démarque grâce à des concepts innovants, des gameplays alternatifs et des univers originaux qui transcendent les frontières du jeu vidéo. Fort de plus de 20 ans d'expérience et de succès, nous mettons notre passion et notre créativité au service du jeu et d’histoires inoubliables. Pour le plaisir de tous . Véritable bras droit du Directeur comptable, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec lui sur tout le périmètre, maison mère comme filiales. Vous aurez la responsabilité de deux comptables généraux ayant chacun un périmètre défini et un comptable client.  Vos principales missions seront : 1- Gestion quotidienne de la tenue de la comptabilité et le bon suivi des obligations : Supervision de la comptabilité clients (suivi des comptes clients et des relances) et générale (provisions, paie, fiscalités, etc.) Echanges continus et réguliers avec la comptabilité fournisseur Assurer le bon suivi de l’établissement des déclarations fiscales et des comptes annuels Assurer le bon suivi du juridique annuel Assurer la gestion des déclarations fiscales de l'entreprise (TVA, IS et autres obligations fiscales). 2- Etablissement des clôtures périodiques (dont la semestrielle et l’annuelle sont publiées) :  Pour les sociétés dont la tenue comptable est internalisée : établissement de clôture complète en collaboration avec les équipes comptables internes Pour les sociétés françaises dont la tenue est externalisée et les sociétés étrangères : assurer le suivi, la communication et la revue des remontées des informations avec la comptable générale en charge Etablissement et suivi des calendriers de clôtures en collaboration avec le contrôle de gestion Veiller au respect des exigences réglementaires et fiscales 3- Audit et Comptes consolidés : Vous serez le.a garant.e de la bonne réciprocité des comptes inter-compagnies  Vous serez l’interlocuteur.trice principal.e auprès de la société qui effectue les comptes consolidés du Groupe.  Point de contact pour les auditeurs autant sur les comptes sociaux que sur les comptes consolidés  Vous aurez un rôle essentiel dans l’établissement des rapports financiers semestriels et annuels qui sont publiés 4- Management : Vous encadrerez une équipe de trois personnes en définissant les priorités et les objectifs de l’équipe en accord vos managers Vous participerez à la montée en compétence des collaborateurs et à la définition de leur plan de formation Vous serez un soutien de l’équipe pour les tâches quotidiennes   5- Projets Transverses Mise en place de process généralisés et homogénéisés des filiales dont la tenue est internalisée en collaboration avec la Direction financière Déploiement et optimisation des process d'automatisation comptable Participer aux projets d'amélioration des processus et des systèmes financiers   Ce que l'on attend de vous :  Véritable référent(e) comptable, vous êtes capable de garantir la fiabilité des comptes tout en accompagnant les évolutions d'une organisation en croissance. Diplômé(e) d'une formation supérieure en Comptabilité, Finance ou Audit (DSCG, Master CCA ou équivalent), vous disposez d'une solide expertise technique. Vous justifiez d 'au moins 5 années d'expérience en cabinet d'audit ou d'expertise comptable OU d'au moins 7 années d'expérience en comptabilité générale au sein d'un environnement international. Vous avez déjà accompagné des projets structurants (croissance externe, intégration de sociétés, évolution des processus ou des outils financiers) et en maîtrisez les impacts comptables, fiscaux et organisationnels. Vous possédez une expérience réussie en management et savez fédérer, développer et faire monter en compétence vos équipes. Vous maîtrisez les normes comptables françaises (French GAAP), ainsi que les réglementations fiscales et sociales françaises. Vous êtes à l'aise avec les outils bureautiques, notamment Excel, et appréciez l'amélioration continue des processus. Vous évoluez avec aisance dans un environnement international et êtes capable d'échanger quotidiennement en anglais, à l'écrit comme à l'oral. Une connaissance de SAP ByDesign constitue un atout apprécié. Ce que l'on dit de vous : Au-delà de vos compétences techniques, nous recherchons un(e) professionnel(le) capable d'accompagner le business avec pragmatisme et leadership. Vous combinez autonomie, rigueur et sens des responsabilités. Vous savez prendre du recul, prioriser et structurer votre activité dans un environnement en constante évolution. Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre capacité à embarquer les équipes et à créer des relations de confiance avec vos interlocuteurs. Pédagogue, vous savez rendre accessibles des sujets comptables, fiscaux ou juridiques complexes auprès d'équipes non spécialistes. Votre sens du dialogue, votre assertivité et votre capacité à influencer avec diplomatie vous permettent d'être un véritable partenaire des directions opérationnelles. Vous appréciez les environnements créatifs, dynamiques et internationaux où l'agilité et la collaboration sont essentielles. Ce que nous offrons : Un environnement de travail structuré et respectueux où l’autonomie est valorisée ; Une culture d’excellence soutenue par un programme interne de formations régulières (techniques, managériales, certifications), adapté aux besoins de chaque collaborateur ; Une reconnaissance et valorisation du travail grâce à nos entretiens annuels et professionnels, ouvrant de réelles perspectives d’évolution et de mobilité interne au sein du Groupe ; Un cadre flexible avec deux jours de télétravail par semaine pour encourager l’équilibre vie professionnelle / vie personnelle ; Des outils de travail modernes facilitant la collaboration et l’efficacité au quotidien ; Des moments réguliers de partage et de convivialité (petits déjeuners, soirées, séminaires) renforçant la cohésion d’équipe ; Une ambiance dynamique avec des activités variées (club de langues, soirées jeux, sports, ateliers créatifs). Informations complémentaires Localisation : Paris 19e Métro ligne 7 – Corentin Cariou / RER E – Rosa Parks Télétravail : 2 jours par semaine Accord d’intéressement Poste à pourvoir immédiatement Conformément aux dispositions du Code du travail relatives à la non-discrimination, notamment en matière de handicap, toutes les candidatures sont examinées à compétences égales. Fort de plus de 20 ans d'expérience et de succès, nous mettons notre passion et notre créativité au service du jeu et d’histoires inoubliables. Pour le plaisir de tous.


Véritable bras droit du Directeur comptable, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec lui sur tout le périmètre, maison mère comme filiales.

Vous aurez la responsabilité de deux comptables généraux ayant chacun un périmètre défini et un comptable client. 

Vos principales missions seront :

1- Gestion quotidienne de la tenue de la comptabilité et le bon suivi des obligations :

  • Supervision de la comptabilité clients (suivi des comptes clients et des relances) et générale (provisions, paie, fiscalités, etc.)

  • Echanges continus et réguliers avec la comptabilité fournisseur

  • Assurer le bon suivi de l’établissement des déclarations fiscales et des comptes annuels

  • Assurer le bon suivi du juridique annuel

  • Assurer la gestion des déclarations fiscales de l'entreprise (TVA, IS et autres obligations fiscales).

2- Etablissement des clôtures périodiques (dont la semestrielle et l’annuelle sont publiées) : 

  • Pour les sociétés dont la tenue comptable est internalisée : établissement de clôture complète en collaboration avec les équipes comptables internes

  • Pour les sociétés françaises dont la tenue est externalisée et les sociétés étrangères : assurer le suivi, la communication et la revue des remontées des informations avec la comptable générale en charge

  • Etablissement et suivi des calendriers de clôtures en collaboration avec le contrôle de gestion

  • Veiller au respect des exigences réglementaires et fiscales

3- Audit et Comptes consolidés :

  • Vous serez le.a garant.e de la bonne réciprocité des comptes inter-compagnies

  •  Vous serez l’interlocuteur.trice principal.e auprès de la société qui effectue les comptes consolidés du Groupe.

  •  Point de contact pour les auditeurs autant sur les comptes sociaux que sur les comptes consolidés

  •  Vous aurez un rôle essentiel dans l’établissement des rapports financiers semestriels et annuels qui sont publiés

4- Management :

  • Vous encadrerez une équipe de trois personnes en définissant les priorités et les objectifs de l’équipe en accord vos managers

  • Vous participerez à la montée en compétence des collaborateurs et à la définition de leur plan de formation

  • Vous serez un soutien de l’équipe pour les tâches quotidiennes

 

5- Projets Transverses

  • Mise en place de process généralisés et homogénéisés des filiales dont la tenue est internalisée en collaboration avec la Direction financière

  • Déploiement et optimisation des process d'automatisation comptable

  • Participer aux projets d'amélioration des processus et des systèmes financiers

 


Ce que l'on attend de vous : 

  • Véritable référent(e) comptable, vous êtes capable de garantir la fiabilité des comptes tout en accompagnant les évolutions d'une organisation en croissance.

  • Diplômé(e) d'une formation supérieure en Comptabilité, Finance ou Audit (DSCG, Master CCA ou équivalent), vous disposez d'une solide expertise technique.

  • Vous justifiez d'au moins 5 années d'expérience en cabinet d'audit ou d'expertise comptable OU d'au moins 7 années d'expérience en comptabilité générale au sein d'un environnement international.

  • Vous avez déjà accompagné des projets structurants (croissance externe, intégration de sociétés, évolution des processus ou des outils financiers) et en maîtrisez les impacts comptables, fiscaux et organisationnels.

  • Vous possédez une expérience réussie en management et savez fédérer, développer et faire monter en compétence vos équipes.

  • Vous maîtrisez les normes comptables françaises (French GAAP), ainsi que les réglementations fiscales et sociales françaises.

  • Vous êtes à l'aise avec les outils bureautiques, notamment Excel, et appréciez l'amélioration continue des processus.

  • Vous évoluez avec aisance dans un environnement international et êtes capable d'échanger quotidiennement en anglais, à l'écrit comme à l'oral.

  • Une connaissance de SAP ByDesign constitue un atout apprécié.

Ce que l'on dit de vous :

Au-delà de vos compétences techniques, nous recherchons un(e) professionnel(le) capable d'accompagner le business avec pragmatisme et leadership.

  • Une ambiance dynamique avec des activités variées (club de langues, soirées jeux, sports, ateliers créatifs).

Définir la stratégie CRM et la roadmap Customer Lifecycle, pour sortir des triggers purement produits et capitaliser sur les moments de vie client. Faire de la connaissance client un avantage compétitif : piloter les outils data, produire des insights actionnables et évangéliser la culture client en interne. Construire le “Next Best Action” et l'orchestration augmentée par l'IA, pour passer d'un CRM intuitif à un CRM cognitif où la décision d'adressage, le canal, la pression et l'offre sont finement automatisés. En forte croissance, sa culture est tech, rapide et collaborative. Ton équipe : 4 personnes aux métiers complémentaires : une PMO CRM, une responsable de la communication client, une cheffe de projet campagnes et une alternante en production. Une équipe compétente, motivée et franchement top ! Ton manager : le CMO, tout juste promu en interne après avoir lui-même porté le périmètre CRM. Très humain et motivant pour ses équipes, c’est un véritable manager-mentor : il connaît le sujet à fond, accompagne la progression de chacun·e et donne les moyens de réussir. Tes interlocuteurs : tu évolues au sein d’une équipe marketing d’une trentaine de personnes, avec des expertises clés en SEO, acquisition payante, marque, contenu et service client. Tu collabores également avec les équipes data, produit et tech, ainsi qu’avec tes homologues à l’international. 💻 Tes Conditions de travail : Ton bureau : de très beaux bureaux, hyper agréables, dans le 17ème arrondissement de Paris, à côté du Parc Monceau. Le midi : pas de cantine, mais une carte tickets restaurant. Ton package de rémunération : Salaire 100% fixe : entre 65 et 80k€ brut annuels, selon expérience. Participation/Intéressement : participation jusqu'à 10% du salaire annuel selon les objectifs d'entreprise (rentabilité, marge), soit jusqu’à 8k€/an. Un intéressement est en cours de mise en place. Autres avantages : très bonne mutuelle, prime annuelle de vacances (environ 800€ cette année), primes culture et sport, soirées au minimum une fois par mois. Ton rythme : 5 semaines de congés payés Une dizaine de jours de RTT par an. Jusqu’à 3 jours de télétravail par semaine (et encore plus de souplesse sur juillet/août). Possibilité de semaine en full-remote durant les fêtes de fin d’année. title: Financial Expertise & Dispute Resolution - Manager
description: Eight Advisory est un cabinet leader sur le marché du conseil financier et opérationnel, indépendant, spécialisé en Transaction, Restructuration et Transformation d’entreprises. Nous accompagnons les dirigeants, les actionnaires, les banques et les investisseurs potentiels dans leurs décisions. En très forte croissance depuis notre création fin 2009, Eight Advisory compte aujourd’hui plus de 1100 collaborateurs dont 129 associés et continue de se développer. Nous sommes présents en France, Belgique, Allemagne, Royaume-Uni, Suisse, Pays-Bas, USA, Espagne, Italie ainsi que dans une trentaine d’autres villes dans le monde à travers notre réseau de cabinets indépendants "Eight International". L’équipe Financial Expertise & Dispute Resolution est spécialisée en évaluation de préjudice et accompagnement sur le volet financier de précontentieux et contentieux en tant qu’expert de partie dans le cadre de procédures amiables, judiciaires, ou arbitrales, mais également en tant que tiers expert. L’équipe Financial Expertise & Dispute Resolution de Eight Advisory, acteur reconnu sur son marché et en fort développement, recherche un futur manager. En tant que consultant manager, vous aurez l’opportunité d’intervenir sur des dossiers pluridisciplinaires afin de développer vos expertises et des compétences transverses sur nos métiers du conseil. Au sein d’une équipe à taille humaine, en forte croissance, vous interviendrez sur des missions d’ : · Evaluation de préjudice et de support aux contentieux à forts enjeux pour nos clients (rupture de relations contractuelles, sinistres industriels, litiges post-acquisition, clauses d’ajustement de prix, responsabilité contractuelle, actions en concurrence déloyale et en contrefaçon, etc.). · Expertise financière dans le cadre de revue de grands projets industriels (analyse de l’origine de dérapage et appréciation des risques associés) et d’accompagnement de sociétés dans le cadre de leur changement stratégique (préparation de business plan, aide à la décision dans le cadre de changement structurel). · Investigation financière liée à des problématiques de détournement d’actifs, de manipulation d’états financiers, d’infraction réglementaire etc. · Analyses de gestion en lien avec une mise en responsabilité du dirigeant en cas de défaillance d’entreprise (analyse de l’origine des difficultés, analyse des flux comptables et financiers, détermination de la date de cessation des paiements, etc.). · Ingénierie financière liée à des enjeux haut de bilan et des enjeux opérationnels. Au quotidien, sous la direction des associés du département, vous serez responsable des travaux suivants : · Conception et réalisation des analyses financières et comptables, · Rédaction des projets de livrable, · Animation de la relation avec les différents intervenants présents sur les missions (clients et avocats), · Encadrement et formation d’une équipe de seniors et d'analystes, · Gestion des aspects administratifs des dossiers (organisation de la mission, facturation, suivi des heures). Vos travaux seront adaptés aux besoins de nos clients et auront pour objectif de créer de la valeur dans des situations complexes de précontentieux ou de contentieux. Vous aurez l’occasion : · De bénéficier d’une diversité d’approches (problématiques financières, juridiques, stratégiques et opérationnelles) ; · D’être exposé aux clients et aux avocats, et notamment de participer aux réunions de présentation de nos analyses et d’échanges avec les opérationnels ; · De faire un travail à haute valeur ajoutée pour nos clients. Vous participerez également à l’identification de nouvelles opportunités et au développement de notre activité (organisation d’évènements, rédaction d’article etc.), et aurez l’opportunité de vous investir sur des projets transverses au sein du cabinet (formation, recrutement, RSE, parrainage des juniors etc.). Diplômé(e) d’une grande école de commerce ou d'un Master CCA, vous justifiez d’une expérience de 5 à 7 ans en cabinet d’audit et vous vous êtes spécialisé(e) en évaluation de préjudice financier. Vous êtes doté (e) de solides bases comptables, de qualités analytiques et rédactionnelles avérées, vous maitrisez l’anglais à l’oral comme à l’écrit et idéalement l’espagnol. Curieux(se), persévérant(e), polyvalent(e), disponible et ambitieux(se), vous savez encadrer des équipes, prendre des initiatives et avez le sens du service client. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

raw.title: Staff Product Engineer - AI Native
raw.description:
Ready to be part of the Legal Tech revolution? 

Vision: 

As a leading software-as-a-service (SaaS) provider, DiliTrust is a global company dedicated to offering an integrated suite of legal and governance products. Our vision is to digitize legal departments worldwide. With an annual growth rate of over 40% since 2020, our ambition is to become the world's leading Legal Tech company, aiming for a valuation exceeding $1 billion by 2026. 

Our Impact: 

From generating General Meeting reports to leveraging AI-assisted contract lifecycle management, our teams in our 8 offices across France, the US, Mexico, MEA, Germany, Spain, Italy, and Canada are the driving force behind our global success. We proudly support 2,400 customers in 64 countries, with 80% of our clientele comprising listed companies in major markets such as Europe, North America, and the Middle East. 

Our Recognition: 

DiliTrust has been at the forefront of Legal Tech innovation, being the first Legal Tech with AI features since 2022. The company is renowned for providing a positive and entrepreneurial work environment. We are honored to have received the "Happy at Work" and "Tech at Work" labels every year since 2019. 

The Role:

Lini is DiliTrust's proprietary AI engine, powering Ask Lini, Risk Detector, Document Summarization, Minute Generation, and every AI capability across the suite.

We are building a dedicated squad around it and are looking for a strong Software / Product Engineer, with a focus our platform architecture, to help us bring it to the next level. 

As a Software Engineer work at the intersection of AI, product, and engineering. You will contribute to building, improving, and scaling the features that make Lini a reliable and powerful AI layer across the entire DiliTrust suite. 

We are looking for an engineer who writes clean, production-ready code and is comfortable taking ownership of features end-to-end, from technical design to deployment. We also care about how you think about AI: whether you bring genuine curiosity to the product, and whether you can translate a model capability into a great user experience. 

Missions

  • Write specifications as the durable asset of the project. Executable acceptance criteria, and — crucially — the non-functional requirements that specs almost never carry: data classification, endpoint × role authorization matrix, volumetry assumptions, latency and throughput budgets. These are the requirements whose later correction is superlinear, so they get decided before generation, not after.
  • Freeze the contracts before any fan-out. API schemas, types, module boundaries, invariants. Agents do not negotiate an interface in the hallway: each will make a plausible and incompatible assumption, discovered at integration.
  • Pilot coding agents with a tight brief and a bounded context — narrow tasks, defined input and output artifacts, explicit stop conditions and budgets, full traceability of what produced each change.
  • Keep producer and verifier separate. You do not sign off alone on generation you piloted, and you act as independent verifier on your peers' slices — with an adversarial brief ("find what breaks against this spec"), never "confirm this looks fine".
  • Build the asymmetric gates that make the slice safe at volume — expensive to satisfy, cheap to check: property tests, contract tests, query-count and allocation budgets, execution-plan checks, policy-as-code, backward-compatibility proofs. Written before the implementation exists, so the agent closes the feedback loop itself without consuming human attention.
  • Use code reading as a calibration instrument, not as a gate. Sample deliberately, by risk zone, to measure the real defect rate of the generator-plus-gates pair and to keep the team's mental model of its own system alive.
  • Keep work-in-progress low. Capped PR size, thin vertical slices, trunk-based with very short branches, feature flags over long-lived branches, CI as the agent's first task rather than its last. More features in flight does not mean faster delivery when the bottleneck is verification.
  • Design for blast radius. Reversibility, progressive delivery, structured logs, traces, metrics and instrumentation generated as a matter of course. On many paths, detecting in five minutes beats three days of review that prevents nothing.

Requirements

Being based in France with full working rights. Fluent in French and English.

Experience & Seniority:

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a significant portion spent building and operating B2B SaaS platforms in production
  • Proven ownership of features across their full lifecycle — design, delivery, iteration, maintenance — on long-lived, multi-year products
  • Strong background in complex, scalable web architectures, including real modularity: you have seen where coupling stops parallel work dead

AI-Native Practice:

  • Demonstrated, sustained use of coding agents in production work — not autocomplete, but delegated implementation with review and accountability
  • A concrete, articulated view of where generated code fails: correlated defects rather than idiosyncratic ones, uniform surface quality that destroys the usual "look here" review signals, plausibility with no author to interrogate
  • Comfort being accountable for code you did not author, and the discipline to refuse a change you cannot explain

Verification & Quality:

  • Real fluency in property-based testing, contract testing, and deriving tests from the specification rather than from the code
  • Test-data strategy, including maintaining a volumetrically representative dataset as part of the verification apparatus — not a nice-to-have
  • Instinct for the difference between a rigorous check and a scalable one: does the cost of checking grow with the volume produced?

Security & Performance (non-negotiable on this role):

  • Authorization modelling in multi-tenant systems, and why declarative, centrally enforced authorization beats reviewing each endpoint. Generated code reliably checks who you are and regularly forgets whether you are allowed
  • Awareness of the attack surface specific to an agent-assisted pipeline: prompt injection through ticket descriptions, code comments and dependency READMEs; supply-chain risk on hallucinated package names; least privilege for non-human identities; and the most frequent risk of all — production data or proprietary code leaking into the development loop
  • Performance as a measured number rather than a code-reading opinion: query budgets per HTTP request, N+1, unbounded result sets, missing indexes on new query paths, network calls in loops, execution-plan review. These are invisible at test-data scale and expensive in production

Product & Team Collaboration:

  • Excellent written communication — specification writing is now a core engineering skill on this role, not documentation overhead
  • Extensive experience working directly with product managers, designers and stakeholders in a product-oriented setup
  • Strong sense of ownership and sound judgment on risk: what to build, what not to build, what residual risk is acceptable and why

Education:

  • Master's degree in Engineering or equivalent practical experience in senior SaaS environments

What this role is not

We would rather say it up front:

  • It is not a prompt-engineering role, and it is not an ML/LLM research role.
  • It is not a role where green tests are sufficient evidence. On security and performance, "the spec is met and the tests pass" is not a weak signal — it is a null one.
  • It is not a ticket queue. The profile that shrinks in an AI-native team is the one whose value was implementing assigned tickets between two boundaries.

Our Tech Stack

  • Backend: Node.js / TypeScript
  • Frontend: Vue.js 3
  • Database: PostgreSQL, MariaDB
  • DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform
  • Cloud: GCP

Engineering apparatus you will use and help build: coding agents orchestrated deterministically in CI, aspect-scoped verification agents (authorization, performance, spec conformance, dependencies), policy-as-code, property-based and contract testing, volumetric test datasets, load and endurance gates on critical paths, feature flags, progressive delivery and end-to-end tracing.

What we offer

  • Join a fast-growing company in a friendly, international environment — engineering primarily in Paris, with further engineering presence in Berlin, Montreal and Wilmington (DE), and offices across France, Italy, Spain, Germany, Canada, the USA, Mexico and Dubai;
  • Our "Remote Policy" guarantees that you can find the right balance between "Onsite" and "Remote";
  • Last but not least, all the day-to-day benefits of the CSE, luncheon vouchers, profit sharing bonuses, etc...

Recruitment process

  • Interview with a TA team member (30/45 mins)
  • Interview with the Engineering Manager (1h)
  • Technical interview (1h30) — two parts: turning an ambiguous requirement into a specification with executable acceptance criteria, then an adversarial review of an agent-generated diff against that specification
  • Interview with the CTO (45 mins)

title: Applied AI Engineer
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Applied AI Engineer based in France. As an Applied AI Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in designing and building the next generation of intelligent, agentic systems. You will develop the core infrastructure that enables AI agents to manage context, use tools, coordinate tasks, and continuously improve their performance. Working at the intersection of advanced AI research and practical software engineering, you will transform complex operational workflows into reliable, scalable production solutions. You will establish robust evaluation, testing, and observability frameworks to ensure AI-powered systems deliver predictable and measurable results. You will also explore innovative ways to integrate coding agents and specialized subagents into software development processes. Collaborating closely with product and operational teams, you will identify high-impact automation opportunities and translate them into effective technical solutions. As an early core member of the engineering team, you will have significant influence over architectural decisions, technical standards, and the long-term AI strategy. Accountabilities In this role, you will design and implement the technical foundations of agentic systems while driving the adoption of AI-powered engineering workflows. Your responsibilities will include: Design and build essential components of agentic systems, including memory, context management, tool-calling capabilities, orchestration mechanisms, and feedback loops. Develop reusable AI infrastructure that enables new workflows to be introduced quickly, consistently, and with predictable reliability. Build comprehensive evaluation frameworks to measure agent performance, identify failure points, and understand the factors behind successful outcomes. Integrate testing, tracing, debugging, and evaluation into the software engineering lifecycle as fundamental practices. Develop systems and validation processes that allow agentic workflows to be thoroughly assessed before production deployment. Advance the use of large language models (LLMs) in software development by creating sophisticated AI-assisted engineering workflows. Build workflows where coding agents and specialized subagents can explore code repositories, implement changes, review architecture, validate conventions, run evaluations, and iterate with minimal human intervention. Actively use agentic engineering tools and workflows in daily development activities. Design architectures that enable specialized AI agents, tools, deterministic software, and human expertise to work together effectively. Determine when to use LLMs, traditional software solutions, human intervention, or coordinated multi-agent approaches to achieve the best outcomes. Collaborate with operational and product teams to understand existing processes, identify high-value automation opportunities, and transform them into reliable production systems. Establish scalable architectural patterns and engineering standards for agentic systems as the organization grows. Take ownership of technical decisions and contribute to the overall direction of the AI engineering function. Requirements The ideal candidate is a strong software engineer with hands-on experience building production-ready AI systems and the autonomy to solve complex technical challenges in a rapidly evolving environment. The following qualifications and skills are expected: Strong software engineering background, with proven experience independently delivering complex systems from initial concept through production deployment. Practical experience building and deploying AI or agentic systems that have operated in production environments. Demonstrated understanding of real-world AI engineering challenges, including reliability, latency, context management, failure modes, evaluation, and observability. Strong knowledge of agent architectures, tool use, structured outputs, context management, orchestration, evaluation frameworks, and feedback loops. Advanced practical experience with modern LLMs and the ability to build reliable workflows around probabilistic AI systems. Hands-on experience using coding agents and agentic development workflows as part of everyday software engineering. Ability to break down complex engineering tasks across multiple agents or specialized subagents and implement mechanisms for validating and improving their outputs. Strong architectural judgment and the ability to select the right combination of AI models, deterministic software, and human intervention for different challenges. Experience with TypeScript and Node.js, or strong experience developing AI systems in Python combined with the willingness and ability to work in a TypeScript-first environment. High level of autonomy, ownership, and confidence making technical decisions in ambiguous situations. Strong product mindset and the ability to connect engineering decisions with operational efficiency and business outcomes. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with fluency in English. Startup mentality, including resilience, adaptability, initiative, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment. Benefits Competitive Compensation: Annual salary ranging from €100,000 to €150,000. Remote Work: Opportunity to work remotely within Europe or the United Kingdom. Early-Team Influence: Join as an early core engineering team member with significant ownership over technical direction and architectural decisions. Technical Autonomy: Shape engineering standards, development practices, tooling, and the foundations of the organization's agentic AI infrastructure. Cutting-Edge Technology: Work extensively with advanced LLMs, autonomous agents, multi-agent architectures, and AI-powered software development workflows. Meaningful Impact: Build production systems that address real operational challenges and deliver measurable business value. Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with product and operational teams to identify opportunities and develop practical automation solutions. Professional Growth: Take on challenging engineering problems while helping establish the foundations of a growing AI-focused organization. description: LA MAISON   Jacquemus a été fondé par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France. Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l’art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.   Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l’appartement parisien d’Auguste Perret (La Croisière).

Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. de vente.

  • Participation à la création des zonings
  • Rédaction de guidelines et documents à destination des points de vente
  • Création de reports photos
  • Réalisation de benchmarks
  • Recherche créative et création de moodboards selon les projets
  • Gestion du stock de props

title: System Architect
description: Hyperscale Power is building the power backbone for the AI data center era: a complete power conversion chain from 13.8kV–35kV medium-voltage AC down to 800V DC, combining ultra-compact SiC-based power blocks. Our Solid-State Transformers (SSTs) are the core of this revolution, providing unprecedented control, efficiency, and compactness. As a System Architect, you will be responsible for our solid-state transformer as a complete system. You will connect the work of our power electronics, magnetics, and mechanical and thermal engineering teams into one coherent system, and ensure it meets the requirements of hyperscale data center customers. Instead of specializing in a single subsystem, your mission is to keep the whole system in view: balancing efficiency, size, cost, reliability and manufacturability, guiding the key technical trade-offs, and taking our SST from prototype to a product ready for certification and series production. This role is for you if… you’ve owned a complex high-power system rather than one part of it. You enjoy keeping the whole picture in view, making the call on trade-offs between expert teams, and bringing just enough structure to a fast-moving team without slowing it down. This role isn’t for you if… you’ve spent your career going deep on a single component or subsystem, or you manage projects without making the technical decisions yourself. It’s also not a fit if you need a fixed specification and established processes before you can start. Key Responsibilities Own the system architecture of the SST and its key performance metrics, including efficiency, power density, cost, thermal performance, reliability, manufacturability and control performance. Coordinate the subsystems of the SST (AC/DC, DC/DC, magnetics, mechanical and thermal) and their interfaces, ensuring the work of each team is compatible and consistent with the system design. Lead system-level trade-off decisions and set technical priorities across teams. Define and maintain system requirements, interface specifications and change management, ensuring design changes are assessed for their impact across the system. Translate the requirements of data center operators and hyperscalers into system specifications, and track how they evolve. Explore and compare different system architectures and their integration in the datacenter power supply chain Drive standardization and design for manufacturing across subsystems in preparation for series production. Work with the compliance and certification team to define a feasible certification path for the system. Identify technical risks at system level early and propose mitigations. Qualifications MSc or a higher degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline. 8+ years of industry experience in developing complex power electronic systems. Proven responsibility at system or platform level, e.g. as system engineer, system architect, technical lead or team lead. Track record of taking power electronic systems from development to series product. Experience with high-power systems such as EV charging, electric drivetrains, rail traction, industrial drives, renewable energy converters or robotics. Broad understanding of the electrical, magnetic, thermal, mechanical and control aspects of power electronic systems, and how they interact. Working knowledge of cooling concepts and the mechanical integration of high-power electronics. Experience with standards, norms and certification processes for power electronic products. Strong communication and decision-making skills; able to align experts across disciplines and drive decisions. Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with evolving requirements. The job will be located at our HQ in Egg b. Zürich, Switzerland. Nice to Have Experience with medium-voltage converter systems or solid-state transformers. Knowledge of data center power architectures. Experience in design for manufacturing and cost engineering. Experience establishing systems engineering processes in a growing organization. Benefits Equity + competitive salary. Unique technology and market opportunity – shape the architecture of a new product category for the energy transition. Hybrid work with flexible working times. description: You take a signed customer and turn them into a flagship reference, owning the journey from first go-live to a full rollout across their plants. Ethon was built to eliminate the trillion-dollar waste problem in manufacturing. We are the technology leader in Industrial AI, building agentic workflows that help manufacturers optimize cost, quality, and speed of production. We serve manufacturers from Siemens and Bosch to Lindt and Roche, and are backed by Index Ventures, General Catalyst, and Earlybird. Our team draws from Palantir, McKinsey, Meta, Google, and top manufacturing companies, all here for the same reason: giving manufacturers the technology to run every factory at unprecedented productivity. WHAT IS THIS JOB ABOUT? You will take a signed logo and turn them into a flagship reference. That means getting onto the shopfloor fast, understanding what drives their KPIs, and deploying Ethon's agentic workflows where the impact is highest. You implement the first use case while already mapping the next. Once one is live, you find the next one. When the engineer is sold, you bring in the plant manager. Once the plant manager is convinced, you get to the COO. This is what you'll do: Own the deployment: You're the person who makes sure go-live happens on time and the customer's team knows how to use it. You handle the onboarding, the training, and the change management that gets a new platform embedded into daily operations. Turn shopfloor problems into business cases: An operator tells you yield drops on line 3 every Tuesday night. You figure out why, quantify what it costs, and build the case for the next deployment. You're as comfortable talking to a process engineer as you are presenting to a VP of Operations. Drive expansion: You know which teams in the account haven't seen Ethon yet, which problems are still unsolved, and what it takes to get the next use case signed. Be on-site: You're in factories. The insights that matter don't come from email chains and slides, they come from being on the floor. Feed the product: You're closest to what customers actually need. You bring that signal back to Engineering and Product and you help us build something better. Work with the team: GTM & Sales brings the logo with your help as a trustworthy industry expert, you take it from there. You work tightly with Engineering on delivery and with the commercial team on expansion opportunities. WHAT DO YOU NEED TO BRING? The best people in this seat combine strategic thinking with the willingness to get their hands dirty on a shopfloor. We can teach you our product. We can't teach you to care about how things get made, or to push hard when a deployment is stuck. You're technically sharp enough to understand a production process and commercially minded enough to turn a pain point into a business case You have 3-5 years of experience in something demanding: consulting, enterprise tech deployment, or a career on the shopfloor You know how to manage complex stakeholder environments, from shopfloor operators to C-suite sponsors You've run change management or adoption programs and know what it takes to get people to actually use new tools You have a builder mindset: when something isn't working, your instinct is to fix it rather than escalate it You're open to travel 30-50% of the time This is how we'll set you up in your first six months: Months 1-2: Learn about product, customers, and how our best deployments get done. You shadow live accounts, learn the platform end-to-end, and expand your understanding of how manufacturers think. You start working on your first account. Months 3-4: You own delivery for one or more accounts, with support from the team. Months 5-6: Full ownership of one or more customers. You're running deployments, driving expansion conversations, and your first upsell is in motion. Great fits tend to come from backgrounds like: Deployment, implementation, or customer success at high-growth industrial tech companies (e.g., Palantir, c3ai, Rockwell, Siemens Digital Industries) where you owned outcomes Top-tier consulting, ready to stop writing recommendations and start executing them Digital transformation or operational excellence roles inside manufacturing companies, where things were moving too slowly for you Manufacturing or process engineering, where you've lived the problems Ethon solves, you know what a plant manager actually cares about, and customers trust you the moment you walk onto their floor A technical degree in chemical, mechanical, electrical engineering, physics, or a related field Bonus: Experience with MES, ERP, Historian, or quality systems in manufacturing environments Fluency in German, French, or another European language WHY IS ETHON RIGHT FOR YOU? We work from our office in the center of Zürich. You will be here three days a week, because the hardest problems get solved in person. Feedback loops are short, access to founders is direct. People who prove themselves here outgrow their title fast. Additionally, we offer: Performance-based career & growth paths On-site work with significant scope for flexible schedules Competitive compensation including stock options giving you a stake in Ethon's long-term success Vacation bonus if you take two consecutive weeks of vacation Flexible parental leave Learning budget for courses, conferences, and coaching If this sounds like your kind of work, we would like to meet you. We're committed to building a team that reflects the diverse world we live in. We encourage applications from all backgrounds, and we especially welcome voices traditionally underrepresented in tech. raw.description:
You take a signed customer and turn them into a flagship reference, owning the journey from first go-live to a full rollout across their plants.

Ethon was built to eliminate the trillion-dollar waste problem in manufacturing. We are the technology leader in Industrial AI, building agentic workflows that help manufacturers optimize cost, quality, and speed of production. We serve manufacturers from Siemens and Bosch to Lindt and Roche, and are backed by Index Ventures, General Catalyst, and Earlybird. Our team draws from Palantir, McKinsey, Meta, Google, and top manufacturing companies, all here for the same reason: giving manufacturers the technology to run every factory at unprecedented productivity.

WHAT IS THIS JOB ABOUT?

You will take a signed logo and turn them into a flagship reference. That means getting onto the shopfloor fast, understanding what drives their KPIs, and deploying Ethon's agentic workflows where the impact is highest. You implement the first use case while already mapping the next. Once one is live, you find the next one. When the engineer is sold, you bring in the plant manager. Once the plant manager is convinced, you get to the COO. This is what you'll do:

  • Own the deployment: You're the person who makes sure go-live happens on time and the customer's team knows how to use it. You handle the onboarding, the training, and the change management that gets a new platform embedded into daily operations.

  • Turn shopfloor problems into business cases: An operator tells you yield drops on line 3 every Tuesday night. You figure out why, quantify what it costs, and build the case for the next deployment. You're as comfortable talking to a process engineer as you are presenting to a VP of Operations.

  • Drive expansion: You know which teams in the account haven't seen Ethon yet, which problems are still unsolved, and what it takes to get the next use case signed.

  • Be on-site: You're in factories. The insights that matter don't come from email chains and slides, they come from being on the floor.

  • Feed the product: You're closest to what customers actually need. You bring that signal back to Engineering and Product and you help us build something better.

  • Work with the team: GTM & Sales brings the logo with your help as a trustworthy industry expert, you take it from there. You work tightly with Engineering on delivery and with the commercial team on expansion opportunities.

WHAT DO YOU NEED TO BRING?

The best people in this seat combine strategic thinking with the willingness to get their hands dirty on a shopfloor. We can teach you our product. We can't teach you to care about how things get made, or to push hard when a deployment is stuck.

  • You're technically sharp enough to understand a production process and commercially minded enough to turn a pain point into a business case

  • You have 3-5 years of experience in something demanding: consulting, enterprise tech deployment, or a career on the shopfloor

  • You know how to manage complex stakeholder environments, from shopfloor operators to C-suite sponsors

  • You've run change management or adoption programs and know what it takes to get people to actually use new tools

  • You have a builder mindset: when something isn't working, your instinct is to fix it rather than escalate it

  • You're open to travel 30-50% of the time

This is how we'll set you up in your first six months:

  • Months 1-2: Learn about product, customers, and how our best deployments get done. You shadow live accounts, learn the platform end-to-end, and expand your understanding of how manufacturers think. You start working on your first account.

  • Months 3-4: You own delivery for one or more accounts, with support from the team.

  • Months 5-6: Full ownership of one or more customers. You're running deployments, driving expansion conversations, and your first upsell is in motion.

Great fits tend to come from backgrounds like:

  • Deployment, implementation, or customer success at high-growth industrial tech companies (e.g., Palantir, c3ai, Rockwell, Siemens Digital Industries) where you owned outcomes

  • Top-tier consulting, ready to stop writing recommendations and start executing them

  • Digital transformation or operational excellence roles inside manufacturing companies, where things were moving too slowly for you

  • Manufacturing or process engineering, where you've lived the problems Ethon solves, you know what a plant manager actually cares about, and customers trust you the moment you walk onto their floor

  • A technical degree in chemical, mechanical, electrical engineering, physics, or a related field

Bonus:

  • Experience with MES, ERP, Historian, or quality systems in manufacturing environments

  • Fluency in German, French, or another European language

WHY IS ETHON RIGHT FOR YOU?

We work from our office in the center of Zürich. You will be here three days a week, because the hardest problems get solved in person. Feedback loops are short, access to founders is direct. People who prove themselves here outgrow their title fast.

Additionally, we offer:

  • Performance-based career & growth paths

  • On-site work with significant scope for flexible schedules

  • Competitive compensation including stock options giving you a stake in Ethon's long-term success

  • Vacation bonus if you take two consecutive weeks of vacation

  • Flexible parental leave

  • Learning budget for courses, conferences, and coaching

If this sounds like your kind of work, we would like to meet you.

We're committed to building a team that reflects the diverse world we live in. We encourage applications from all backgrounds, and we especially welcome voices traditionally underrepresented in tech.

title: Engineering Manager
description: Who is Sonar? Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow,  Booking.com , Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development. Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence.   Position Description As an Engineering Manager at Sonar, you will lead a squad of 8 developers to build, automate and operate software used by millions of Sonar customers worldwide. You will own the professional growth and development of your team, enabling them to build well-crafted software for our products, and promoting a high-performance engineering culture.  You will improve our products by leading the elaboration of the squad's annual and quarterly objectives in close collaboration with the AI team while contributing to and overseeing technical architecture and engineering direction.  You will help to bring consistency across Sonar’s engineering organization by collaborating closely with your engineering manager peers to foster and share engineering best practices. What you will do Lead and manage a team of Engineers, providing guidance, support, and mentorship to help individuals grow in autonomy and contribute to the team's success. Hold yourself and your team accountable to a high engineering standard. Foster a safe culture of feedback, continuous improvement, and collaboration, encouraging team members to share their ideas and concerns openly. Align feedback with other teams to ensure things operate smoothly between teams. Partner with product managers, designers, and team leads to develop and communicate a clear vision for the squad that aligns with the company strategy and ensure that the team's work and focus align with this vision. Ensure the squad defines clear objectives that are aligned with team, department, and company goals. Be accountable for tracking sprint progress. Be accountable that processes and ceremonies align with company expectations to deliver the best product successfully. Ensure that the right level of collaboration happens with the squad stakeholders (Product Managers, developer squads, Marketing, Management, etc.). Partner with the Hiring team to recruit talented Engineers for the team. Participate in improving the hiring process for the team and ensuring we recruit enough to reach our goals. Be accountable that the onboarding of new team members is happening in the squad. Lead by example, modeling the behaviors and values that the company holds dear, including humility and servant leadership. Experience and qualifications The technical skills you will demonstrate 8+ years of software development or equivalent experience in the software development domain, with a strong understanding of software testing.  Having a developer mindset: experience with coding lifecycle, ability to produce secure code, to do code reviews, and to jump into an unknown codebase, language, and framework. Advanced knowledge of the Java ecosystem Good knowledge of at least one programming language along with its development environment to understand end-user's context and expectations. Experience with Agile methodologies.   The leadership skills you will demonstrate 3+ years of experience in a leadership or management role, with a proven track record of delivering results and building high-performing teams. A growth mindset and a passion for helping individuals and teams reach their full potential. Strong decision-making skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and resources effectively. Capability to make concrete progress in the face of ambiguity and imperfect knowledge.   The soft skills you will demonstrate Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to clearly identify the problem to be solved and articulate it, before jumping to possible solutions/actions. Ability to deliver effective feedback. Good listening skills. raw.title: Engineering Manager
raw.description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. 


Position Description

As an Engineering Manager at Sonar, you will lead a squad of 8 developers to build, automate and operate software used by millions of Sonar customers worldwide. You will own the professional growth and development of your team, enabling them to build well-crafted software for our products, and promoting a high-performance engineering culture. 

You will improve our products by leading the elaboration of the squad's annual and quarterly objectives in close collaboration with the AI team while contributing to and overseeing technical architecture and engineering direction. 

You will help to bring consistency across Sonar’s engineering organization by collaborating closely with your engineering manager peers to foster and share engineering best practices.


What you will do

  • Lead and manage a team of Engineers, providing guidance, support, and mentorship to help individuals grow in autonomy and contribute to the team's success.

  • Hold yourself and your team accountable to a high engineering standard.

  • Foster a safe culture of feedback, continuous improvement, and collaboration, encouraging team members to share their ideas and concerns openly.

  • Align feedback with other teams to ensure things operate smoothly between teams.

  • Partner with product managers, designers, and team leads to develop and communicate a clear vision for the squad that aligns with the company strategy and ensure that the team's work and focus align with this vision.

  • Ensure the squad defines clear objectives that are aligned with team, department, and company goals.

  • Be accountable for tracking sprint progress.

  • Be accountable that processes and ceremonies align with company expectations to deliver the best product successfully.

  • Ensure that the right level of collaboration happens with the squad stakeholders (Product Managers, developer squads, Marketing, Management, etc.).

  • Partner with the Hiring team to recruit talented Engineers for the team. Participate in improving the hiring process for the team and ensuring we recruit enough to reach our goals.

  • Be accountable that the onboarding of new team members is happening in the squad.

  • Lead by example, modeling the behaviors and values that the company holds dear, including humility and servant leadership.

    The technical skills you will demonstrate

  • 8+ years of software development or equivalent experience in the software development domain, with a strong understanding of software testing.

  • Good knowledge of at least one programming language along with its development environment to understand end-user's context and expectations.

title: CFO (Mitglied der Geschäftsleitung)
description: Das Universitäre Zentrum für Zahnmedizin Basel (UZB) vereint Patientenbehandlung, akademische Lehre und Forschung unter einem Dach. Mit rund 300 Mitarbeitenden, rund 100'000 Behandlungen pro Jahr und einem Umsatz von ca. CHF 40 Mio. erbringt das UZB seine Leistungen unter anderem auf Basis von Leistungsaufträgen mit der Universität Basel und dem Kanton Basel-Stadt. Wir suchen eine oder einen CFO mit überzeugenden betriebswirtschaftlichen und finanziellen Kenntnissen. Als Mitglied der Geschäftsleitung ist neben dem Finanzwissen auch unternehmerisches Denken und Handeln gefragt, um das Unternehmen gesamtheitlich zu steuern und weiterzuentwickeln. Ihre Verantwortung Sie verantworten die finanzielle Führung des UZB – von der Budget-, Liquiditäts- und Finanzplanung über das Rechnungswesen und die Rechnungslegung nach Swiss GAAP FER bis hin zum Controlling – und stellen ein aussagekräftiges, stufengerechtes Reporting an unsere Leitungserbringer, die Geschäftsleitung und den Verwaltungsrat sicher. Sie sichern die Finanzierung und Liquidität, entwickeln das Risikomanagement und das interne Kontrollsystem weiter und sind Ansprechperson für den Prüfungsausschuss des Verwaltungsrats und die Revisionsstelle. Sie führen und entwickeln die Bereiche Finanzen (rund 10 Mitarbeitende), IT (3), Technischer Dienst (3) und Einkauf mit vier direkt unterstellten Führungspersonen und fördern die Zusammenarbeit über Fachgrenzen hinweg. Sie bringen die Digitalisierung und Weiterentwicklung von Abläufen und Systemen voran und entscheiden bei der laufenden Evaluation einer neuen ERP-Lösung massgeblich mit. Als Mitglied der Geschäftsleitung tragen Sie auch die gesamtunternehmerische Verantwortung mit und bringen sich in Fragen der Unternehmensentwicklung aktiv ein. Sie beraten die CEO und die Geschäftsleitung als Sparringpartner in allen betriebswirtschaftlichen Fragen und erarbeiten Business Cases für neue Angebote und Projekte. Sie schaffen Entscheidungsgrundlagen für den Dialog mit internen und externen Anspruchsgruppen in einem öffentlich-rechtlich geprägten Umfeld und pflegen den Kontakt zu den relevanten Stakeholdern. Ihr beruflicher Hintergrund Sie verfügen über substanzielles Know-how in Finanzen und Controlling sowie über Erfahrung in einer verantwortlichen Finanzführungsfunktion. Sie haben einen (Fach-) Hochschulstudium in Betriebswirtschaft abgeschlossen oder sind Expertin bzw. Experte in Rechnungslegung und Controlling; Erfahrung mit Swiss GAAP FER und SAP ist von Vorteil. Sie haben Führungserfahrung, sind es gewohnt bei Entscheidungsprozessen mitzuwirken und anschliessend die Entscheidungen in ihrem Verantwortungsbereich konsequent umzusetzen. Sie kommunizieren differenziert und transparent, arbeiten pragmatisch und verbinden finanzielle Sorgfalt mit Offenheit für neue Lösungen. Sie verfügen über stilsichere Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse. Sie interessieren sich für Digitalisierung und einen verantwortungsvollen Umgang mit Daten und neuen Technologien. Erfahrung im Gesundheitswesen oder in einer öffentlich-rechtlichen Organisation sind willkommen, doch keine Voraussetzung. Was die Aufgabe auszeichnet Das UZB ist eine dynamische Institution: 2016 gegründet und seit 2021 um rund 30 % gewachsen. Unsere Strukturen, Prozesse und Systeme lassen sich aktiv mitprägen. Sie verbinden eine finanzielle Schlüsselrolle mit der Möglichkeit, die Weiterentwicklung einer Unternehmung mit gesellschaftlichem Auftrag aus Geschäftsleitungsperspektive mitzugestalten. Die Position verlangt Nähe zum Tagesgeschäft ebenso wie einen verlässlichen Blick auf das Ganze. Interessiert? Vertraulicher Erstkontakt Sie möchten mehr erfahren? title: Sr. Specialist Solutions Architect
description: <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []">FEQ228R125</p> <p>As a Senior Specialist Solutions Architect (Sr. SSA) for AI/ML, you will be the go-to technical expert for Databricks' AI platform across our customers. You will help them move from AI experiments to <strong>governed, cost-efficient agents and ML systems running on the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform</strong>.</p> <p>You will work with Account Executives and Solutions Architects to win strategic opportunities. You will design architectures for advanced agent and ML use cases and lead hands-on proofs of concept and MVPs. You will act as a trusted advisor to customer technical leaders on AI strategy, governance and economics. You will also shape our AI go-to-market in the region, enable the wider field team, and feed what you learn from customers back to Product and Engineering.</p> <p>This role reports to the Manager, Specialist Solutions Architects – Switzerland, Austria &amp; Eastern Europe.</p> <h3><strong>The impact you will have</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Win the technical decision for AI on Databricks.</strong> Lead discovery, architecture design, demos, proofs of concept and MVPs for agent, GenAI and ML use cases in competitive evaluations.</li> <li><strong>Design production-grade agent systems.</strong> Architect agents and multi-agent applications using Agent Bricks, Databricks Apps, MCP tools, Lakebase, AI Search and the Foundation Model APIs. Govern assets under Unity Catalog</li> <li><strong>Make agent quality measurable.</strong> Help customers build evaluation and observability into everything they ship, using MLflow tracing, domain-specific LLM judges, labelled evaluation datasets, release gates and production monitoring.</li> <li><strong>Govern AI at enterprise scale.</strong> Position the AI Gateway as the central control point for model access, guardrails, PII protection, usage tracking and rate limiting.</li> <li><strong>Scale your expertise.</strong> Enable SAs and partners with workshops, reusable assets and reference architectures.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Influence the product.</strong> Bring structured customer feedback and requirements specific to the market to Product Management and Engineering.</li> <li><strong>Be a visible voice.</strong> Represent Databricks at customer executive briefings, meetups, conferences and in written content.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we look for</strong></h3> <ul> <li>7+ years of hands-on experience in machine learning, AI engineering or data science, including customer-facing technical work (pre-sales, consulting or technical leadership).</li> <li><strong>A track record of shipping LLM and agent systems to production</strong>, not just prototypes, including evaluation, monitoring and cost management.</li> <li>Deep knowledge of agent architecture: tool use and function calling, MCP, agent memory and state, orchestrating multiple agents, and retrieval and context design.</li> <li>Strong practical experience <strong>evaluating GenAI systems</strong>: tracing, LLM-as-a-judge, building evaluation datasets, regression testing and observability in production.</li> <li>Hands-on with at least one modern agent framework (e.g. LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK, DSPy). You should be framework-agnostic in how you design.</li> <li>Solid understanding of the foundation-model landscape (e.g. Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, open-weight models) and the trade-offs between quality, latency, cost and data residency.</li> <li>Strong grounding in classical ML and MLOps: model development, deployment, monitoring and lifecycle management at scale.</li> <li>Strong software engineering skills in Python and SQL.
