title: Technology Marketing Manager
description: About the role We are looking for a Technology Marketing Manager to turn Neural Concept’s platform, technology, and long-term vision into compelling stories for engineers and executives. This role sits at the intersection of product, engineering, marketing, and go-to-market . You will develop a deep understanding of Neural Concept’s technology and work closely with leadership and cross-functional teams to create and continuously improve how our platform is explained to enterprise audiences. Your work will directly shape how global enterprises perceive Neural Concept: not as a point solution, but as an intelligence layer that brings AI into engineering workflows , helping Global 2000 engineering leaders design better products faster. This is a high-impact role with significant autonomy, offering the opportunity to take ownership of complex topics, shape Neural Concept’s technical and market narrative, and potentially grow into leading a product marketing team as the company scales. What you will do Technology & Product Narrative Develop a deep, hands-on understanding of Neural Concept’s platform, technology, and roadmap. Act as a primary internal reference for market-facing technology and product narratives. Turn complex technical concepts into clear explanations, examples, and value stories for engineering and executive audiences. Work closely with leadership and Product to ensure alignment between vision, roadmap, and market messaging. Messaging & Positioning Framework Structure and maintain the core messaging framework in collaboration with leadership and Sales Enablement. Define how Neural Concept’s technology is positioned across personas, industries, and use cases. Ensure consistency and clarity across all market-facing materials (website, flagship assets, campaigns). Clearly articulate technical differentiation and competitive positioning in a factual, grounded way. Content Strategy & Creation Own and produce technology- and product-driven content across flagship assets (hero blogs, whitepapers, product pages, decks). Translate ongoing technical innovation into concrete, high-quality content that can be used externally by customers, partners, and sales teams. Partner with the Design team to shape and produce high-quality product and technology content, including diagrams, visual explanations, demos and videos. Go-to-Market Foundations (in collaboration) Produce use-case content, value stories, and messaging inputs that Sales Enablement and Marketing actively use in customer conversations and campaigns. Collaborate with Sales Enablement to ensure product and technology narratives are translated into clear, consistent sales messaging. Support entry into new industries or use cases by clarifying positioning and value stories, without owning sales strategy or execution. Cross-functional Collaboration Partner closely with Product, Applied Engineering, Sales Enablement, Marketing, and Leadership. Act as a bridge between technical teams and market-facing functions. Contribute to strategic discussions on positioning, category evolution, and long-term narrative. Who you are Experience & Skills 5+ years of experience in technology marketing, technical product marketing, or market-facing technical roles within B2B or deep-tech companies. You combine technical depth with a strong sense for marketing and storytelling, whether you built it in a marketing role or on the technical side. Demonstrated ability to deeply understand complex technology platforms and systems, and reason about how they create value in real-world engineering workflows. Engineering background (e.g., mechanical, aerospace, or computational engineering) or hands-on familiarity with CAD, CAE, or simulation tools is a strong plus. Experience working closely with product and engineering teams to translate technical capabilities, constraints, and trade-offs into clear market positioning. Proven ability to structure and maintain coherent messaging and positioning frameworks grounded in technical reality. Track record of producing substantial, high-quality marketing content for complex technical products. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt the message to very different audiences, from engineers and technical experts to executives, decision-makers, and non-technical stakeholders. Comfortable engaging in technical discussions and asking the right questions to build accurate, credible market narratives. Fluent in English, written and spoken. About the role

We are looking for a Technology Marketing Manager to turn Neural Concept’s platform, technology, and long-term vision into compelling stories for engineers and executives.

This role sits at the intersection of product, engineering, marketing, and go-to-market.

You will develop a deep understanding of Neural Concept’s technology and work closely with leadership and cross-functional teams to create and continuously improve how our platform is explained to enterprise audiences.

Your work will directly shape how global enterprises perceive Neural Concept: not as a point solution, but as an intelligence layer that brings AI into engineering workflows, helping Global 2000 engineering leaders design better products faster.

This is a high-impact role with significant autonomy, offering the opportunity to take ownership of complex topics, shape Neural Concept’s technical and market narrative, and potentially grow into leading a product marketing team as the company scales.

What you will do

Technology & Product Narrative

  • Develop a deep, hands-on understanding of Neural Concept’s platform, technology, and roadmap.

  • Act as a primary internal reference for market-facing technology and product narratives.

  • Turn complex technical concepts into clear explanations, examples, and value stories for engineering and executive audiences.

  • Work closely with leadership and Product to ensure alignment between vision, roadmap, and market messaging.

Messaging & Positioning Framework

  • Structure and maintain the core messaging framework in collaboration with leadership and Sales Enablement.

  • Define how Neural Concept’s technology is positioned across personas, industries, and use cases.

  • Ensure consistency and clarity across all market-facing materials (website, flagship assets, campaigns).

  • Clearly articulate technical differentiation and competitive positioning in a factual, grounded way.

Content Strategy & Creation

  • Own and produce technology- and product-driven content across flagship assets (hero blogs, whitepapers, product pages, decks).

  • Translate ongoing technical innovation into concrete, high-quality content that can be used externally by customers, partners, and sales teams.

  • Partner with the Design team to shape and produce high-quality product and technology content, including diagrams, visual explanations, demos and videos.

Go-to-Market Foundations (in collaboration)

  • Produce use-case content, value stories, and messaging inputs that Sales Enablement and Marketing actively use in customer conversations and campaigns.

  • Collaborate with Sales Enablement to ensure product and technology narratives are translated into clear, consistent sales messaging.

  • Support entry into new industries or use cases by clarifying positioning and value stories, without owning sales strategy or execution.

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Product, Applied Engineering, Sales Enablement, Marketing, and Leadership.

  • Act as a bridge between technical teams and market-facing functions.

  • Contribute to strategic discussions on positioning, category evolution, and long-term narrative.

Who you are

Experience & Skills

  • 5+ years of experience in technology marketing, technical product marketing, or market-facing technical roles within B2B or deep-tech companies.

  • You combine technical depth with a strong sense for marketing and storytelling, whether you built it in a marketing role or on the technical side.

  • Demonstrated ability to deeply understand complex technology platforms and systems, and reason about how they create value in real-world engineering workflows.

  • Engineering background (e.g., mechanical, aerospace, or computational engineering) or hands-on familiarity with CAD, CAE, or simulation tools is a strong plus.

  • Experience working closely with product and engineering teams to translate technical capabilities, constraints, and trade-offs into clear market positioning.

  • Proven ability to structure and maintain coherent messaging and positioning frameworks grounded in technical reality.

  • Track record of producing substantial, high-quality marketing content for complex technical products.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt the message to very different audiences, from engineers and technical experts to executives, decision-makers, and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Comfortable engaging in technical discussions and asking the right questions to build accurate, credible market narratives.

  • Fluent in English, written and spoken.

  • Able to operate with a high degree of autonomy while staying closely aligned with leadership and peers.

  • Execution-oriented, pragmatic, and hands-on.

  • Open, direct, and collaborative in working across functions.

title: Expansion Associate (H/F) - 100%
description: Tu n'abandonnes pas au premier refus, ni au dixième. Tu traites une liste le vendredi après-midi avec le même soin que le lundi matin, et tu mènes à terme ce que tu as commencé, pour que rien ne reste en suspens et que rien ne vieillisse en silence dans un coin. Tu n'as besoin de personne derrière ton épaule pour tenir ton niveau d'exigence. Et quand un cas ne rentre pas dans le processus, tu le signales au lieu de bricoler une solution. Si tu te reconnais dans ces lignes, tu es au bon endroit. En tant qu' Expansion Associate , tu es le chasseur ou la chasseuse d'appartements de Room Estate en Suisse romande , avec un accent sur Genève. Tu es responsable de l'acquisition d'appartements de A à Z : tu passes le marché au crible, tu évalues chaque appartement sous l'angle du coliving, tu le visites sur place, tu postules en notre nom, tu relances et tu accompagnes le dossier jusqu'à la signature du bail. C'est un rôle pour les personnes qui passent à l'action, et c'est précisément sa force : fréquence, ténacité et sens des responsabilités dans un processus clairement défini. Notre principe directeur : la croissance naît d'un tri des annonces à haute fréquence, d'une évaluation rigoureuse et de relances systématiques, pas de coups de chance. Tu travailles en étroite collaboration avec notre responsable de l'équipe Acquisition, qui tranche les cas d'appréciation, et ton travail se mesure à ce qui compte au final : les chambres acquises, les baux signés et la qualité de ce que tu ramènes. Tasks Tu passes les portails immobiliers au crible de manière systématique , chaque jour et avec un regard sûr pour ce qui convient. Tu évalues chaque appartement sous l'angle du coliving : plan, état, immeuble, et la question de savoir si la propriété est prête à jouer le jeu. Tu organises les visites et tu te rends sur place pour vérifier sur l'objet réel ce que promet l'annonce. Tu postules en notre nom et tu positionnes Room Estate comme le locataire que toute régie souhaite avoir. Tu relances jusqu'à ce qu'une décision soit prise. Aucun dossier ne s'enlise. Tu accompagnes le dossier jusqu'à la signature et tu contrôles le bail à l'aide de notre liste de contrôle : points critiques, clauses manquantes et écarts par rapport à l'annonce. Tu tiens le suivi des dossiers à jour : chaque objet saisi, chaque statut traçable. Requirements Sens des responsabilités et autonomie. Tu fais avancer un processus de bout en bout à une fréquence élevée et à un rythme fiable, tu vas au bout de chaque suivi et tu ne laisses aucun dossier s'enliser. C'est le cœur de ce rôle. Maîtrise du français, à l'écrit comme à l'oral, dans les échanges avec les régies et les propriétaires. Ténacité et sens de la négociation, le marché locatif genevois dit souvent non, et cela ne te déstabilise pas. Un œil pour les plans, tu vois d'emblée si le coliving fonctionne dans un appartement et combien de chambres sont réalistes. Rigueur dans le travail avec des listes de contrôle, tu vas au bout de chaque point plutôt que de faire les choses à peu près, et tu repères les écarts. Aucune connaissance spécialisée en droit du bail n'est requise. Permis de conduire catégorie B et disponibilité pour des visites régulières à Genève, dans la région lémanique et dans le reste de la Suisse romande. title: MSF International Managing Director
description: Location: Based in Geneva or within approximately +/- two (2) hours from Geneva Contract: Fixed term at 100% - It is a mandated role (currently 3+3 years) Starting date: 01st of March 2027 Deadline to apply: 26th of November 2026 - We reserve the right to close this position once suitable candidates have been identified. Compensation and Benefits: MSF practice is to offer the compensation and benefits package in line with the MSF entity offering the contract *By default, the successful candidate will be offered a contract in the MSF office, able to issue a contract, of their country of residence at the time of application. If no MSF office exists in their country of residence, the successful candidate will be expected to relocate to a country where an MSF office can issue a contract, provided the local legislation allows for that. At MSF, we are committed to an inclusive culture that encourages and supports the diverse voices of our employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, nationalities, races, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics. MSF is committed to preventing abuse, inappropriate behaviour, lack of integrity and financial misconduct in its work and care spaces. The successful candidate will be expected to comply with the organisation’s safeguarding policies and standards of professional behaviour. We are committed to removing barriers for people with specific accessibility needs. If you need an adjustment to the recruitment process to be considered for the role, please let us know from the beginning of the selection process. MSF International Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international, independent, medical humanitarian organisation that delivers emergency aid to people affected by armed conflict, epidemics, healthcare exclusion and natural disasters. MSF offers assistance to people based only on need and irrespective of race, religion, gender or political affiliation. MSF International is the legal entity that binds MSF’s 26 sections, 28 associations and 16 branch offices together. Registered in Switzerland, MSF International provides coordination, information and support to the MSF Movement, as well as implements international projects and initiatives as requested. I. CONTEXT Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international, independent medical humanitarian organisation providing emergency assistance to people affected by armed conflict, epidemics, healthcare exclusion and natural disasters, based solely on need and irrespective of race, religion, gender or political affiliation. MSF International is the legal entity whose membership is composed of all MSF associations. It hosts the International Secretariat, supports the International Board, facilitates coordination across the MSF movement, and provides shared services and initiatives as mandated by the movement. Within MSF International, the International Office acts as the Secretariat of the International Board (IB) and operates under the direct management of the International Secretary General (ISG). MSF International also provides administrative and operational support to movement-wide initiatives and services, including MSF Access. II. PURPOSE OF THE JOB The MSF International Managing Director is a senior executive role responsible for institutional leadership, stewardship of resources, and organizational performance of MSF International as a legal entity serving the MSF movement. The role ensures that MSF International: Effectively implements -within the scope of MSF International - the MSF International Multiyear Plan and SPARC (MSF-wide Strategic Planning, Accountability and Resource Cycle) and supports the International Board and the International Secretary General in their governance roles and responsibilities. Provides high quality, well governed services to the MSF movement, as mandated by the Full ExCom (executive committee); Operates with strong systems of governance, accountability, risk management and duty of care; Has robust, transparent and efficient governance, financial, human, and knowledge systems; Operates as a coherent, inclusive, and accountable internationally distributed organization; Models MSF values in leadership, equity, duty of care, and ethical management; Ensures that the decisions taken by the Board of Directors of MSF International and its implementation is compliant with the Articles of Association, the internal regulations, as well as Swiss standards and Swiss laws, for as long as the registered office is in Geneva, Switzerland. The MSF Management Director acts as a strategic partner to the International Secretary General, providing leadership on transversal and institutional topics with regards to the management of MSF International. III. ACCOUNTABILITIES 1. Strategic Leadership and Implementation of MSF International (Multi‑year Plan & SPARC): Lead the translation of MSF International and movement strategic priorities into clear objectives, organisational plans, policies and resourcing within MSF International; support cross‑functional initiatives required by international platforms as needed to deliver the Multi‑Year Strategic Plan and SPARC commitments. Expected result: MSF International delivers on agreed strategic priorities and SPARC commitments through coherent plans, measurable milestones and coordinated delivery across functions and movement partners. a. Contribute to the development of MSF International Multi‑year Strategic Plan and SPARC within MSF International’s mandate and scope and translate strategic priorities into concrete organisational objectives, policies, systems and resource allocations, ensuring coherence across functions and services. b. Supports cross‑functional and transversal initiatives required to deliver common strategic priorities and SPARC‑related commitments. c. Contribute to movement-wide discussions on harmonization, efficiency and shared services. d. Sets up and tracks implementation plans, including key milestones, indicators, and risks. Support the ISG in reporting to the International Board and relevant Standing Committees, and contribute to SPARC’s Monitoring & Evaluation Framework and Expense Steering Process for functions and services managed within MSF International’s scope. e. Deputize for the ISG as required, within agreed scope and representation mandates. f. Represent MSF International to key stakeholders, partners and external audiences as required, and build relationships that protect and advance MSF's institutional interests. 2. Governance, legal compliance, accountability and risk management for MSF-International: Ensure robust governance implementation, statutory compliance and effective risk management systems for MSF International as a Swiss legal entity and for services delivered on behalf of the movement; prepare governance-level advice and support Board decision-making. Expected result: International Board and executive decisions are supported by timely, compliant and risk‑informed advice; MSF International statutory obligations and legal requirements are met and organisational risks are identified and mitigated. a. Act as senior management liaison to the ISG, the International Board and Standing Committees on matters related to MSF International organisational governance, resources, risk, compliance and organisational performance. b. Ensure robust systems of internal control, risk management and accountability, are in place and functioning for MSF International, in line with legal, fiduciary and associative obligations, including preparedness for critical incidents directly affecting MSF International. c. Lead or support organizational responses to critical incidents directly affecting MSF International, including HR, legal, reputational, safeguarding or security‑related situations. d. Ensure that MSF International fulfils its statutory responsibilities as a Swiss legal entity and that appropriate legal, administrative and governance support is obtained for decisions of the IB in light of the International Statutes, the Internal Regulations, and Swiss standards and law. Ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations regarding daily management of MSF International. e. Oversee compliance with GDPR and Swiss data protection law, promoting a culture of privacy and responsible data use. f. Ensure appropriate legal review of all contracts and agreements directly involving MSF International and including those through which it delivers services to the movement, in accordance with MSF’s rules and policies, as well as Swiss law. g. Design, implement and monitor the effectiveness of internal control systems and procedures; ensure that MSF International risks are identified and registered and ensure that mitigation measures are discussed and incorporated in the respective departments annual plans. 3. Services to MSF: Provide executive stewardship of movement-wide services mandated to MSF International, ensuring clear service governance, defined accountabilities and cost‑effective delivery. Expected result: Movement services operate to agreed service charters and KPIs, with transparent costs and reliable delivery that meet sections' needs and contractual obligations. a. Provide executive leadership and stewardship over services mandated to MSF International in support of the MSF movement, ensuring they are clearly governed, fit for purpose, cost‑effective and appropriately funded. b. Ensure that roles, responsibilities, decision‑making authority and service boundaries between MSF International and MSF sections are clearly defined and communicated, balancing interoperability and mutualization objectives with the sections and ODs autonomy. c. Establish and monitor service governance and performance frameworks, including service charters, KPIs, cost‑sharing arrangements and escalation mechanisms where relevant, and ensure transparency. d. Facilitate structured dialogue with MSF sections to identify service needs, manage expectations and address risks or performance issues. 4. Financial stewardship and institutional integrity: Oversee budgeting, financial planning, statutory accounts, audits and financial controls; ensure alignment of resources with strategic priorities and manage institutional financial and insurance arrangements. Expected result: MSF International maintains sound financial health, regulatory compliance and transparent resource allocation that supports strategic objectives. a. Provide executive oversight of budgeting, forecasting and financial reporting for MSF International. b. Ensure alignment between strategic priorities (including SPARC) and resource allocation. c. Oversee statutory accounts, audits, financial policies and compliance with Swiss GAAP, tax and VAT requirements. d. Oversee relationships with external auditors, financial advisors and legal counsel. e. Oversee institutional insurance coverage and financial risk mitigation. Manage the full suite of institutional and corporate insurance coverage for MSF International. f. Oversee legacies and donations earmarked for MSF International 5. People, culture and organisational development: Oversee people strategy, workforce planning, performance management, leadership development and organisational design to foster an inclusive, safe and high‑performing culture across a distributed workforce. Expected result: A diverse, supported and capable organisation with clear succession pathways, strong performance management and a positive organisational culture. a. Provide strategic leadership over human resources management, organizational design and workforce planning. b. Ensure a safe, supportive, inclusive, equitable, diverse, respectful, and healthy workplace, free from abuse and other misconduct. c. Oversee performance management, leadership development and succession planning. d. Ensure a lively MSF International culture despite the geographical spread, including through adequate internal communication. e. Lead organisational development, when necessary, to ensure the organisational structure remains fit for purpose and appropriate for a well-functioning office. f. Manage institutional relationships with MSF sections hosting MSF International staff and ensure coherent frameworks for hosting, contracting, payroll and staff integration. g. Ensure appropriate information governance and that knowledge management systems support collaboration, institutional memory and organizational learning, including learning from strategy and SPARC implementation. h. Liaise regularly with the Staff Committee of MSF International. IV. AUTONOMY, COMPLEXITY The MSF International Managing Director operates with a high degree of autonomy to think, interpret and act within the strategic direction set by the International Secretary General, the International Board and the governance framework of MSF International. The role is required to make independent judgements on organisational priorities, resource allocation, risk mitigation, service performance, people matters and operational responses, often in situations where issues are sensitive, cross-functional and without straightforward precedent. The complexity of the environment is significant: the postholder works across a federated MSF movement with multiple stakeholders, distributed teams, hosted staff arrangements and diverse section interests, while also ensuring compliance with Swiss legal and regulatory requirements, internal governance rules, financial and HR procedures, safeguarding standards and data protection obligations. Success therefore depends on balancing institutional coherence, legal and procedural rigour, and service effectiveness with diplomacy, sound judgement and the ability to operate in ambiguity. V. SAFEGUARDING REQUIREMENTS FOR THE ROLE The incumbent commits to contribute to a safe, supportive, inclusive, equitable, diverse, respectful, and healthy workplace, free from abuse and other misconduct. They will not engage in any form of abuse including those detailed in MSF Typologies of Abuse and when an employee suspects or observes abuse, they will report it (without investigating it) to protect others. Ensure respectful management and communication at all levels. Ensure that staff and consultants under their supervision understand their responsibilities with respect to required behaviour and report abuse while working for MSF by reinforcing and regularly discussing expected standards of behaviour. Welcome complainants, understand how to guide colleagues to appropriate channels, promote and create an environment that does not tolerate abuse or inappropriate behaviour. Guide colleagues to the correct process without investigating. Ensure that staff know how to complain and keep staff updated on reporting mechanisms. Education Master’s degree in management, humanitarian affairs, political sciences, or a related field, or equivalent senior-level professional experience Experience Extensive senior leadership experience (General/Executive Director, Deputy Director or Director of a major organizational function) in a complex and large international and decentralised organisations MSF experience is a major asset Proven ability to operate at Board and executive level Strong people leadership, including conflict management and change leadership Solid expertise in financial oversight, governance and organisational systems Experience with equity, diversity and inclusion strategies Knowledge Strong commitment to MSF’s humanitarian principles and associative values. High level of integrity and ability to handle confidential and sensitive matters. Knowledge of Swiss legal, institutional, employment, financial and data protection frameworks is an asset. Familiarity with governance of associations and federated movements is an asset. Proven ability to lead cross-functional and institutional change. Comfortable leading teams across different locations and liaising with stakeholders at all levels. Excellent written and verbal communication, able to communicate complex or sensitive matters clearly, concisely, and professionally. High level of discretion, judgement, and emotional intelligence, and the ability to build a strong network across an organisation. Confident decision‑making and the ability to act autonomously as appropriate. Flexible team player, willing to adapt to changes, and confident tackling unfamiliar challenges across multiple domains of knowledge/experience. Languages Excellent English (written and spoken) is essential. French highly desirable, and other MSF languages are further assets. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. By submitting an application, the job applicant confirms their understanding and acceptance of these recruitment procedures. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

  • Effectively implements -within the scope of MSF International - the MSF International Multiyear Plan and SPARC (MSF-wide Strategic Planning, Accountability and Resource Cycle) and supports the International Board and the International Secretary General in their governance roles and responsibilities.

  • Provides high quality, well governed services to the MSF movement, as mandated by the Full ExCom (executive committee);

  • Operates with strong systems of governance, accountability, risk management and duty of care;

  • Has robust, transparent and efficient governance, financial, human, and knowledge systems;

  • Operates as a coherent, inclusive, and accountable internationally distributed organization;

  • Models MSF values in leadership, equity, duty of care, and ethical management;

  • Ensures that the decisions taken by the Board of Directors of MSF International and its implementation is compliant with the Articles of Association, the internal regulations, as well as Swiss standards and Swiss laws, for as long as the registered office is in Geneva, Switzerland.

The MSF Management Director acts as a strategic partner to the International Secretary General, providing leadership on transversal and institutional topics with regards to the management of MSF International.

III. ACCOUNTABILITIES

1. Strategic Leadership and Implementation of MSF International (Multi‑year Plan & SPARC): Lead the translation of MSF International and movement strategic priorities into clear objectives, organisational plans, policies and resourcing within MSF International; support cross‑functional initiatives required by international platforms as needed to deliver the Multi‑Year Strategic Plan and SPARC commitments.

Expected result: MSF International delivers on agreed strategic priorities and SPARC commitments through coherent plans, measurable milestones and coordinated delivery across functions and movement partners.

a. Contribute to the development of MSF International Multi‑year Strategic Plan and SPARC within MSF International’s mandate and scope and translate strategic priorities into concrete organisational objectives, policies, systems and resource allocations, ensuring coherence across functions and services.

b. Supports cross‑functional and transversal initiatives required to deliver common strategic priorities and SPARC‑related commitments.

c. Contribute to movement-wide discussions on harmonization, efficiency and shared services.

d. Sets up and tracks implementation plans, including key milestones, indicators, and risks. Support the ISG in reporting to the International Board and relevant Standing Committees, and contribute to SPARC’s Monitoring & Evaluation Framework and Expense Steering Process for functions and services managed within MSF International’s scope.

e. Deputize for the ISG as required, within agreed scope and representation mandates.

f. Represent MSF International to key stakeholders, partners and external audiences as required, and build relationships that protect and advance MSF's institutional interests.

2. Governance, legal compliance, accountability and risk management for MSF-International: Ensure robust governance implementation, statutory compliance and effective risk management systems for MSF International as a Swiss legal entity and for services delivered on behalf of the movement; prepare governance-level advice and support Board decision-making.

Expected result: International Board and executive decisions are supported by timely, compliant and risk‑informed advice; MSF International statutory obligations and legal requirements are met and organisational risks are identified and mitigated.

a. Act as senior management liaison to the ISG, the International Board and Standing Committees on matters related to MSF International organisational governance, resources, risk, compliance and organisational performance.

b. Ensure robust systems of internal control, risk management and accountability, are in place and functioning for MSF International, in line with legal, fiduciary and associative obligations, including preparedness for critical incidents directly affecting MSF International.

c. Lead or support organizational responses to critical incidents directly affecting MSF International, including HR, legal, reputational, safeguarding or security‑related situations.

d. Ensure that MSF International fulfils its statutory responsibilities as a Swiss legal entity and that appropriate legal, administrative and governance support is obtained for decisions of the IB in light of the International Statutes, the Internal Regulations, and Swiss standards and law. Ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations regarding daily management of MSF International.

e. Oversee compliance with GDPR and Swiss data protection law, promoting a culture of privacy and responsible data use.

f. Ensure appropriate legal review of all contracts and agreements directly involving MSF International and including those through which it delivers services to the movement, in accordance with MSF’s rules and policies, as well as Swiss law.

g. Design, implement and monitor the effectiveness of internal control systems and procedures; ensure that MSF International risks are identified and registered and ensure that mitigation measures are discussed and incorporated in the respective departments annual plans.

3. Services to MSF: Provide executive stewardship of movement-wide services mandated to MSF International, ensuring clear service governance, defined accountabilities and cost‑effective delivery.

Expected result: Movement services operate to agreed service charters and KPIs, with transparent costs and reliable delivery that meet sections' needs and contractual obligations.

a. Provide executive leadership and stewardship over services mandated to MSF International in support of the MSF movement, ensuring they are clearly governed, fit for purpose, cost‑effective and appropriately funded.

b. Ensure that roles, responsibilities, decision‑making authority and service boundaries between MSF International and MSF sections are clearly defined and communicated, balancing interoperability and mutualization objectives with the sections and ODs autonomy.

c. Establish and monitor service governance and performance frameworks, including service charters, KPIs, cost‑sharing arrangements and escalation mechanisms where relevant, and ensure transparency.

d. Facilitate structured dialogue with MSF sections to identify service needs, manage expectations and address risks or performance issues.

4. Financial stewardship and institutional integrity: Oversee budgeting, financial planning, statutory accounts, audits and financial controls; ensure alignment of resources with strategic priorities and manage institutional financial and insurance arrangements.

Expected result: MSF International maintains sound financial health, regulatory compliance and transparent resource allocation that supports strategic objectives.

a. Provide executive oversight of budgeting, forecasting and financial reporting for MSF International.

b. Ensure alignment between strategic priorities (including SPARC) and resource allocation.

c. Oversee statutory accounts, audits, financial policies and compliance with Swiss GAAP, tax and VAT requirements.

d. Oversee relationships with external auditors, financial advisors and legal counsel.

e. Oversee institutional insurance coverage and financial risk mitigation. Manage the full suite of institutional and corporate insurance coverage for MSF International.

f. Oversee legacies and donations earmarked for MSF International

5. People, culture and organisational development: Oversee people strategy, workforce planning, performance management, leadership development and organisational design to foster an inclusive, safe and high‑performing culture across a distributed workforce.

Expected result: A diverse, supported and capable organisation with clear succession pathways, strong performance management and a positive organisational culture.

a. Provide strategic leadership over human resources management, organizational design and workforce planning.

b. Ensure a safe, supportive, inclusive, equitable, diverse, respectful, and healthy workplace, free from abuse and other misconduct.

c. Oversee performance management, leadership development and succession planning.

d. Ensure a lively MSF International culture despite the geographical spread, including through adequate internal communication.

e. Lead organisational development, when necessary, to ensure the organisational structure remains fit for purpose and appropriate for a well-functioning office.

f. Manage institutional relationships with MSF sections hosting MSF International staff and ensure coherent frameworks for hosting, contracting, payroll and staff integration.

g. Ensure appropriate information governance and that knowledge management systems support collaboration, institutional memory and organizational learning, including learning from strategy and SPARC implementation.

h. Liaise regularly with the Staff Committee of MSF International.

IV. AUTONOMY, COMPLEXITY

The MSF International Managing Director operates with a high degree of autonomy to think, interpret and act within the strategic direction set by the International Secretary General, the International Board and the governance framework of MSF International.

The role is required to make independent judgements on organisational priorities, resource allocation, risk mitigation, service performance, people matters and operational responses, often in situations where issues are sensitive, cross-functional and without straightforward precedent.

The complexity of the environment is significant: the postholder works across a federated MSF movement with multiple stakeholders, distributed teams, hosted staff arrangements and diverse section interests, while also ensuring compliance with Swiss legal and regulatory requirements, internal governance rules, financial and HR procedures, safeguarding standards and data protection obligations. Success therefore depends on balancing institutional coherence, legal and procedural rigour, and service effectiveness with diplomacy, sound judgement and the ability to operate in ambiguity.

V. SAFEGUARDING REQUIREMENTS FOR THE ROLE

The incumbent commits to contribute to a safe, supportive, inclusive, equitable, diverse, respectful, and healthy workplace, free from abuse and other misconduct. They will not engage in any form of abuse including those detailed in MSF Typologies of Abuse and when an employee suspects or observes abuse, they will report it (without investigating it) to protect others.

  • Ensure respectful management and communication at all levels.

  • Ensure that staff and consultants under their supervision understand their responsibilities with respect to required behaviour and report abuse while working for MSF by reinforcing and regularly discussing expected standards of behaviour.

  • Welcome complainants, understand how to guide colleagues to appropriate channels, promote and create an environment that does not tolerate abuse or inappropriate behaviour. Guide colleagues to the correct process without investigating.

  • Ensure that staff know how to complain and keep staff updated on reporting mechanisms.

raw.title: Engineering Manager
raw.description:
Geef richting aan de toekomst van high-tech elektronica.

Van medische apparatuur en industriële systemen tot geavanceerde semicon-oplossingen: onze Electrical Engineers staan aan de basis van technologie die wereldwijd wordt toegepast. Ben jij de leider die energie krijgt van het ontwikkelen van mensen, kennis en technische excellence? Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

 

Als Electrical Engineering Manager beweeg jij je op het snijvlak van technologie, leiderschap en organisatieontwikkeling. Daarbij richt je je niet alleen op de resultaten van vandaag, maar ook op de technische uitdagingen van morgen. Je stimuleert kennisontwikkeling, versterkt engineering excellence en helpt richting te geven aan de verdere groei van Electrical Engineering binnen Benchmark.

 

Je geeft leiding aan een team van circa 40 engineers en speel je een belangrijke rol in de verdere ontwikkeling van een van de grootste technische disciplines binnen Benchmark. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit, groei en prestaties van de organisatie en creëert een omgeving waarin engineers kunnen excelleren, innoveren en zich blijven ontwikkelen.

 

Met jouw visie op leiderschap, talentontwikkeling en technologie bouw je aan een sterke engineeringcultuur waarin vakmanschap, samenwerking en continue verbetering centraal staan. Zo zorg je ervoor dat onze Electrical Engineering-organisatie klaar blijft voor de complexe technologische vraagstukken van onze klanten én de ambities van de toekomst.

 

Jij combineert technisch leiderschap, people management en strategische ontwikkeling. Daarom ben jij verantwoordelijk voor:

  • Het aansturen, coachen en ontwikkelen van circa 40 Electrical Engineers.

  • Het leiden van de AI-transformatie binnen Electrical Engineering.

  • Het neerzetten van een duidelijke visie op Electrical Engineering en het vertalen hiervan naar de praktijk.

  • Het stimuleren van innovatie, kennisontwikkeling en technische excellentie binnen het vakgebied.

  • Het ontwikkelen van competenties, groeipaden en vakmanschap binnen jouw team.

  • Het bewaken van de kwaliteit, capaciteit en inzetbaarheid van de afdeling.

  • Het ondersteunen en adviseren van Program Managers bij complexe ontwikkelprojecten.

  • Het aantrekken, selecteren en ontwikkelen van technisch talent.

  • Het versterken van de samenwerking met internationale engineering teams binnen Benchmark.

  • Het bijdragen aan organisatie brede besluitvorming als onderdeel van het Competence Management Team en aan een lerende organisatie waarin kennisdeling, ontwikkeling en continue verbetering centraal staan.

 

Samen met de managers van Software Engineering, Mechanical Engineering en Test Development Engineering werk je aan de verdere ontwikkeling van de totale engineeringorganisatie. Daarnaast werk je nauw samen met collega’s uit andere disciplines, waaronder HR. Omdat het aantrekken en ontwikkelen van talent in deze schaarse arbeidsmarkt essentieel is, beschik je over een sterk professioneel netwerk en weet je talent aan je team en organisatie te verbinden.

 

Waarom deze functie?

Deze rol biedt de unieke kans om invloed uit te oefenen op zowel de technische richting als de ontwikkeling van een grote groep professionals. Je werkt in een omgeving waar complexe technologie, internationale samenwerking en persoonlijke groei samenkomen.

 

Wat biedt Benchmark?

Bij Benchmark werk je aan producten die ertoe doen! Daarnaast zijn wij bij uitstek een organisatie waar je vrijheid krijgt, waar ondernemerschap wordt beloond en waarin je de ruimte krijgt om je ideeën tot uitvoering te brengen. We bieden je een dynamische omgeving met de ruimte om snel stappen te maken, door te groeien en verantwoordelijkheid te nemen. Je bent onderdeel van een wereldwijd bedrijf waar de nuchtere Twentse cultuur bewaard is gebleven.

 

Bij ons krijg je uitdagend werk, veel vertrouwen en ruimte om jezelf te blijven ontwikkelen. Je werkt met nuchtere collega’s in een informele cultuur, met goede voorwaarden om duurzaam te presteren.

 

Daarnaast bieden wij:

  • Een aantrekkelijk salaris passend bij de verantwoordelijkheden en het potentieel binnen de rol.

  • Een bonusregeling gekoppeld aan de prestaties van jouw team en de organisatie.

  • Een managementcontract met veel ruimte voor ondernemerschap, eigen verantwoordelijkheid en impact op de verdere ontwikkeling van de organisatie.

  • Persoonlijke groei en ontwikkeling, waarbij we samen een ontwikkelpad creëren dat aansluit op jouw ambities en de behoeften van de organisatie.

  • Flexibiliteit in de inrichting van je werkweek, met ruimte om werk en privé op een manier te combineren die voor jou werkt.

  • Een sterk kennisgedreven engineeringklimaat, waarin samenwerking, kennisdeling en innovatie centraal staan. Via initiatieven zoals Lunch & Learn-sessies en Pitch Discovery Sessions krijg je volop ruimte om te leren, te inspireren en nieuwe ideeën te ontwikkelen.

 

Wie ben jij?

Of je nu een ervaren engineering manager bent of toe bent aan je eerste grotere leiderschapsrol, jij krijgt energie van technologie én het ontwikkelen van mensen. Je weet professionals te verbinden, richting te geven en samen resultaten te behalen in een complexe high-tech omgeving. Met jouw technische achtergrond, nieuwsgierigheid en leiderschapspotentieel bouw je mee aan de volgende generatie engineers én innovaties. Je combineert flexibiliteit met een sterke interesse in technologie, bent van nature nieuwsgierig en floreert in een agile omgeving. Herken jij jezelf hierin? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

 

Daarnaast zien wij graag:

  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in embedded software, elektrotechniek, natuurkunde  of een vergelijkbare technische richting.

  • Je hebt een stevige achtergrond in electrical engineering en voldoende technische diepgang om met engineers en architecten te sparren over technische keuzes en ontwikkelrichtingen.

  • Minimaal zeven jaar ervaring binnen een hightech-ontwikkelomgeving, inclusief enkele jaren in een leidinggevende rol of een technische leiderschapsrol.

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met het aansturen, coachen en ontwikkelen van engineeringteams binnen een complexe technische organisatie.

  • Het vermogen om technische visie, organisatiedoelstellingen en talentontwikkeling succesvol met elkaar te verbinden.

  • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden en een goede beheersing van zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal.

 

Serious Tech
Bij Benchmark werk je voor bedrijven die impact maken met hun innovaties. Zo ontwikkelen we nieuwe producten die de veiligheid of gezondheid verbeteren of juist het gemak vergroten. Deze producten worden geleverd vanaf het productontwerp tot en met volumeproductie en soms ook rechtstreeks aan de eindgebruiker. Dit gehele proces wordt geheel in Almelo uitgevoerd, waar we samenwerken met ongeveer 650 collega’s

 

We werken aan innovaties voor, onder andere, semicon, gezondheidszorg, aerospace en industrie. Van productontwerp tot volumeproductie: het hele proces komt hier samen. Technisch ligt de lat hoog, maar de cultuur blijft nuchter en dichtbij. Je werkt met mensen die verantwoordelijkheid nemen, elkaar helpen en samen willen blijven verbeteren.

 

Seriously you?

We zoeken mensen die energie krijgen van complexe technologie en niet terugdeinzen voor een stevige uitdaging. Mensen die verantwoordelijkheid pakken, ideeën delen en samen willen blijven verbeteren. Herken jij jezelf daarin? Dan praten we graag verder.

title: Stage Frontoffice
description: Wat ga je doen? Een goede eerste indruk maken én jezelf ontwikkelen in gastvrijheid en communicatie? Daar krijg je tijdens jouw meewerkstage bij de Frontoffice volop de kans voor. Je bent een van de eerste aanspreekpunten voor bezoekers en bellers en leert hoe je hen vriendelijk en professioneel helpt. Je ontvangt gasten bij de receptie, neemt de telefoon op en voert verschillende administratieve werkzaamheden uit. Zo doe je in de praktijk ervaring op met receptiewerk, telefonie, hospitality, communicatie en administratie. Omdat we internationaal werken, krijg je ook te maken met buitenlandse bezoekers en telefoongesprekken. Je hoeft natuurlijk nog geen perfecte Engelse gesprekken te voeren. Het belangrijkste is dat je het leuk vindt om Engels in de praktijk te gebruiken en hierin steeds beter te worden. Wanneer het rustiger is bij de Frontoffice, dan ondersteun je bij Travel. Je helpt bijvoorbeeld met de administratie rondom zakelijke reizen, het verwerken en controleren van reisgegevens en, waar mogelijk, het boeken van hotels en vluchten. Zo ontdek je niet alleen hoe de Frontoffice werkt, maar krijg je ook inzicht in het organiseren van zakelijke reizen. Concreet ga je je bezighouden met: Bezoekers ontvangen en leren hoe je zorgt voor een gastvrije en professionele ontvangst; De telefoon aannemen en bellers doorverbinden of verder helpen; Ervaring opdoen met Nederlandse én Engelse telefoongesprekken; Werken met administratieve werkzaamheden en systemen; Ondersteunen bij Travel, bijvoorbeeld bij het verwerken en controleren van reisgegevens; Waar mogelijk helpen bij het boeken van hotels en vluchten voor zakelijke reizen; Steeds zelfstandiger meedraaien in de dagelijkse werkzaamheden van de Frontoffice. Het belangrijkste resultaat van jouw stage? Dat je steeds zelfstandiger kunt meedraaien bij de Frontoffice en jezelf verder ontwikkelt in gastvrijheid, communicatie en administratie. Daarnaast krijg je inzicht in Travel en leer je hoe de organisatie van zakelijke reizen er in de praktijk aan toegaat. Wij vragen Een mbo-opleiding in de richting van administratie, hospitality, toerisme of vergelijkbaar. Je bent gastrvij en vindt het leuk om mensen te helpen; Je werkt nauwkeurig en bent georganiseerd; Je durft initiatief te nemen en bent leergierig; Wij bieden Een vergoeding: €600,- per maand; Reiskostenvergoeding: zodat jij geen onnodige kosten maakt; Apparatuur en materialen: bijvoorbeeld een laptop of software; Ervaren coach: goede begeleiding is belangrijk en dus krijg je een vaste coach om je te ondersteunen; Ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Over Voortman Wat in 1968 begon in een kippenschuur in Rijssen, is uitgegroeid tot wereldspeler in CNC-staalbewerkingsmachines. Met een team van meer dan 750 collega’s wereldwijd ontwikkelen en bouwen we niet alleen high-end machines, maar ook slimme software en service waarop klanten kunnen vertrouwen. title: Applied AI Engineer
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Applied AI Engineer based in Netherlands. As an Applied AI Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in designing and building the next generation of intelligent, agentic systems. You will develop the core infrastructure that enables AI agents to manage context, use tools, coordinate tasks, and continuously improve their performance. Working at the intersection of advanced AI research and practical software engineering, you will transform complex operational workflows into reliable, scalable production solutions. You will establish robust evaluation, testing, and observability frameworks to ensure AI-powered systems deliver predictable and measurable results. You will also explore innovative ways to integrate coding agents and specialized subagents into software development processes. Collaborating closely with product and operational teams, you will identify high-impact automation opportunities and translate them into effective technical solutions. As an early core member of the engineering team, you will have significant influence over architectural decisions, technical standards, and the long-term AI strategy. Accountabilities In this role, you will design and implement the technical foundations of agentic systems while driving the adoption of AI-powered engineering workflows. Your responsibilities will include: Design and build essential components of agentic systems, including memory, context management, tool-calling capabilities, orchestration mechanisms, and feedback loops. Develop reusable AI infrastructure that enables new workflows to be introduced quickly, consistently, and with predictable reliability. Build comprehensive evaluation frameworks to measure agent performance, identify failure points, and understand the factors behind successful outcomes. Integrate testing, tracing, debugging, and evaluation into the software engineering lifecycle as fundamental practices. Develop systems and validation processes that allow agentic workflows to be thoroughly assessed before production deployment. Advance the use of large language models (LLMs) in software development by creating sophisticated AI-assisted engineering workflows. Build workflows where coding agents and specialized subagents can explore code repositories, implement changes, review architecture, validate conventions, run evaluations, and iterate with minimal human intervention. Actively use agentic engineering tools and workflows in daily development activities. Design architectures that enable specialized AI agents, tools, deterministic software, and human expertise to work together effectively. Determine when to use LLMs, traditional software solutions, human intervention, or coordinated multi-agent approaches to achieve the best outcomes. Collaborate with operational and product teams to understand existing processes, identify high-value automation opportunities, and transform them into reliable production systems. Establish scalable architectural patterns and engineering standards for agentic systems as the organization grows. Take ownership of technical decisions and contribute to the overall direction of the AI engineering function. Requirements The ideal candidate is a strong software engineer with hands-on experience building production-ready AI systems and the autonomy to solve complex technical challenges in a rapidly evolving environment. The following qualifications and skills are expected: Strong software engineering background, with proven experience independently delivering complex systems from initial concept through production deployment. Practical experience building and deploying AI or agentic systems that have operated in production environments. Demonstrated understanding of real-world AI engineering challenges, including reliability, latency, context management, failure modes, evaluation, and observability. Strong knowledge of agent architectures, tool use, structured outputs, context management, orchestration, evaluation frameworks, and feedback loops. Advanced practical experience with modern LLMs and the ability to build reliable workflows around probabilistic AI systems. Hands-on experience using coding agents and agentic development workflows as part of everyday software engineering. Ability to break down complex engineering tasks across multiple agents or specialized subagents and implement mechanisms for validating and improving their outputs. Strong architectural judgment and the ability to select the right combination of AI models, deterministic software, and human intervention for different challenges. Experience with TypeScript and Node.js, or strong experience developing AI systems in Python combined with the willingness and ability to work in a TypeScript-first environment. High level of autonomy, ownership, and confidence making technical decisions in ambiguous situations. Strong product mindset and the ability to connect engineering decisions with operational efficiency and business outcomes. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with fluency in English. Startup mentality, including resilience, adaptability, initiative, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment. Benefits Competitive Compensation: Annual salary ranging from €100,000 to €150,000. Remote Work: Opportunity to work remotely within Europe or the United Kingdom. Early-Team Influence: Join as an early core engineering team member with significant ownership over technical direction and architectural decisions. Technical Autonomy: Shape engineering standards, development practices, tooling, and the foundations of the organization's agentic AI infrastructure. Cutting-Edge Technology: Work extensively with advanced LLMs, autonomous agents, multi-agent architectures, and AI-powered software development workflows. Meaningful Impact: Build production systems that address real operational challenges and deliver measurable business value. Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with product and operational teams to identify opportunities and develop practical automation solutions. Professional Growth: Take on challenging engineering problems while helping establish the foundations of a growing AI-focused organization. We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer in our Amsterdam office to build Alwin, our Agentic Automation Platform for audit and finance, and the systems around it. Alwin agents run multi-step audit procedures over client evidence and return finished workpapers with every number traced back to source. Humans plan, review and sign off.

This is a hands-on role: most of your time will be spent writing code, building the hardest parts of the runtime, prototyping new capabilities and getting them into production. You lead by example: engineers follow your direction because they see it work in your code. Your impact will also come through the engineers and teams you work with.

Your mission is to build the best agentic runtime for audit: one that completes audit tasks faster, more accurately, more reliably and at lower cost, while scaling to meet the needs of our largest customers.

You will identify the problems that most constrain that mission, align teams around a technical direction and drive solutions through to measurable results, while building the foundations other engineers use and raising the quality of Alwin’s agents in production.

Why DataSnipper?

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.

And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way.

What You Will Do:

Results You Will Drive

  • Better audit outcomes: improve how accurately and reliably agents complete real audit tasks, with traceable results and human oversight.

  • A faster, more efficient runtime: reduce execution time and cost while scaling to more complex workloads and larger customers.

  • More capable teams: build foundations and feedback loops that multiple teams use to ship and improve agents faster.

Build & Ship

  • Write production code every week on the most complex and critical parts of Alwin

  • Build proofs of concept for new agent capabilities, and take the ones that work all the way to production

  • Champion experimentation and R&D: try emerging models and techniques, solve hard problems creatively, and turn promising ideas into reliable features

  • Build shared capabilities that multiple teams adopt, and remain accountable for whether they make those teams faster and their products more reliable

  • Contribute directly to the agent harness at the core of Alwin: the orchestration, tools, context and evaluation loops every agent runs on

  • Anticipate where the platform needs to be in 12 to 18 months, and make design decisions now that minimize the cost of future change

  • Improve how teams build Alwin by establishing tooling and feedback loops that help them detect agent failures, prioritize improvements, prevent regressions and ship production-ready agents faster

  • Jump into the hardest incidents across teams, resolve immediate problems and turn what you learn into lasting, systemic fixes

  • Make the trade-offs between model cost, latency and accuracy explicit, and measure them in production

title: Bookkeeper (Boekhouder)
description: Monumental is automating on-site construction with robotics and software. Our mission is to make construction software-defined and autonomous - a future where beautiful, bespoke buildings go up in a single day, with minimal labour. We're a growing team of engineers, operators and technicians from diverse backgrounds, including consumer tech, finance and media, and companies like Dyson, Shopify, Meta and Tesla. It's still the early days of building the company, and this is a chance to make an outsized impact on a problem that matters. From day one, you'll be working with an experienced founding team, backed by a $32M Series B led by Khosla Ventures and Plural, alongside other renowned investors. Monumental is based in the city centre of Amsterdam, in a beautiful facility with a fully equipped workshop and robot testing floor. We build the whole stack in-house, hardware and software. Our work involves building robots in our workshop and houses on real construction sites, so we're onsite five days a week. Read more on why we believe you should spend your time working on construction, and learn about our vision and company . You might enjoy our YouTube Channel , Based in Europe’s film on how we’re fixing Europe’s housing shortage , or this video by Andreas Klinger of what our office looks like . About the role We're looking for a Bookkeeper to bring our day-to-day bookkeeping and month-end close in-house. You'll be our first dedicated bookkeeper, taking over from our external accounting firm and running the books for our growing group: five Dutch BVs today, plus our entities abroad. Our transaction volume has roughly doubled this year, and 2027 is the first financial year our accounts will be audited. You'll own the reconciliations, records and close process that make our numbers reliable, working closely with our finance lead, purchasing team and external accountants. The external accountants will continue to handle annual accounts and corporate tax, with local advisors handling tax filings abroad. This is a hands-on bookkeeping role for someone with at least three years of experience running the full cycle through month-end. Our data and processes need cleaning up. If you enjoy turning a messy administration into a tidy one, this is that job. As you settle in, there is room to take on VAT filing and monthly payroll processing. The role is based at our Amsterdam HQ, on-site five days a week. Salary is up to €50,000 gross a year, including the 8% holiday allowance. What you'll do Own daily bookkeeping. Code supplier invoices and card spend in Spendesk with the right GL account, VAT code and cost centre, and post them to the general ledger without re-keying. Keep supplier records clean and prepare payment runs. Supplier bank-detail changes are independently verified and approved; payment approval and release sit with the finance lead. Keep accounts reconciled. Reconcile bank accounts, keep payables and receivables current, and investigate outstanding items so every balance is supported or explained. Run the month-end close. Close all entities to a fixed timetable, initially by working day eight and moving towards working day five. Own accruals, prepayments and balance-sheet reconciliations, collect or prepare foreign entities' figures, agree intercompany balances and reconcile group reporting to the ledgers. Maintain fixed assets and inventory records. Keep the fixed-asset register up to date, including capitalisation and depreciation of our robot fleet under agreed accounting policies, and reconcile inventory accounts to month-end stock values. Prepare Dutch VAT returns. Prepare quarterly btw returns with our external accountants reviewing, and take over filing them over time. Keep the books audit-ready. Maintain supporting schedules and an audit file throughout the year. Be a day-to-day contact for our external accountants and support the audit of our 2027 accounts. Improve how we work. Document the close, fix recurring errors and use spreadsheets, software and AI tools to reduce manual work while checking the results carefully. Depending on your experience, take on payroll processing in Loket over time, with payroll tax filings remaining with our external accountants. What we're looking for Full-cycle bookkeeping experience. You have at least three years of experience running the books through month-end, at an accounting firm (accountantskantoor) or in-house. Hands-on Dutch VAT experience. You've prepared Dutch btw returns and can work through the supporting records. Strong reconciliation skills. You've handled balance-sheet reconciliations, accruals and prepayments, beyond processing invoices. You investigate differences and follow them through to a resolution. Accuracy and ownership. You keep records organised, meet close deadlines and raise missing information or accounting questions early. You'd rather find the €12 difference than book it to suspense. Fluent English and professional working Dutch. English is our working language, and your manager doesn't speak Dutch. You can independently read and process Dutch invoices, tax correspondence and payroll documents. Comfort with systems and confidential information. You work confidently with spreadsheets, learn new accounting tools and handle financial and employee information carefully. Nice to have: Twinfield, Basecone or Spendesk (Exact, Odoo or similar also counts); multi-entity or multi-country bookkeeping, intercompany and consolidation; fixed-asset or inventory accounting in hardware or manufacturing; statutory audit support; Dutch payroll experience, ideally in Loket; an accounting qualification such as MBO-4/HBO, SPD or Praktijkdiploma Boekhouden; experience automating repetitive work. Why Monumental? Joining Monumental means being at the forefront of a movement aimed at making significant strides in the construction industry. Here, your work has the potential to impact not just the company but the future of how we build. If you're driven by innovation, eager to tackle complex challenges, and ready to make a tangible difference, we want to hear from you. For open applications (where you don't see an exact role match), please reach out to us at: Unfortunately we do not currently support internships. If you don't meet all the qualifications here but are excited about Monumental and feel you'd still be able to help us tackle complex challenges, do get in touch. We welcome generalists who focus on outcomes and are eager to learn on the job. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

Facturen worden correct verwerkt en tijdig ter goedkeuring en betaling aangeboden. Je houdt overzicht over openstaande posten en acties en schakelt tijdig wanneer de voortgang dreigt vast te lopen. Collega’s weten je te vinden en jij weet wie je moet benaderen om zaken verder te brengen. De workflows en autorisatieschema’s in 4cee zijn actueel en je hebt bijgedragen aan een efficiënter factuurverwerkingsproces. Tijdens de maand- en jaarafsluiting lever je de benodigde informatie tijdig en zorgvuldig aan. Wie jij bent Je werkt nauwkeurig en gestructureerd en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor je werk. Je stelt prioriteiten, houdt overzicht en wacht niet af wanneer iets blijft liggen. Je zoekt actief de samenwerking op en spreekt collega’s op een prettige, duidelijke manier aan op openstaande acties. Je bent nieuwsgierig, leert graag en denkt mee over hoe processen beter kunnen. Een internationale technische omgeving spreekt je aan en je vindt het leuk om vanuit Finance bij te dragen aan een organisatie in de wereld van gaming, infrastructuur en hosting. Je hebt een afgeronde mbo-opleiding in een financiële richting en minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in een vergelijkbare financiële administratieve functie, bij voorkeur binnen de crediteurenadministratie. Ervaring met verschillende btw-codes en het correct toepassen daarvan bij de verwerking van inkoopfacturen. Praktische kennis van Excel en affiniteit met financiële systemen en digitale factuurverwerking. Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands en Engels voor contact met collega’s en internationale leveranciers. Beschikbaarheid van minimaal 24 uur per week, met ten minste twee vaste dagen op kantoor in Rotterdam. Ervaring met NetSuite en 4cee is een pré. Waarom werken bij i3D.net ? Maak het verschil: Draag bij aan een solide financiële basis voor een internationaal bedrijf met een jarenlange staat van dienst. Hybride werken Profiteer van flexibel hybride werken, een thuiswerkbudget en hoogwaardige hulpmiddelen. Ruimte om te groeien Ontwikkel je verder met een vergoeding voor opleidingen, loopbaanbegeleiding en mogelijkheden om je kennis en vaardigheden uit te breiden. Aantrekkelijke arbeidsvoorwaarden Een marktconform salaris, een jaarlijkse bonus, 25 vakantiedagen naast de officiële feestdagen, een reiskostenvergoeding en een premievrije pensioenregeling. Blijf in beweging Maak gratis gebruik van onze eigen fitnessruimte in Rotterdam. title: Forward Deployed Engineer | Finance
description: Jij zorgt dat AI niet bij een financiële pilot blijft, maar helpt in het echte werk. Een slimme AI-demo maakt indruk. Maar pas als analisten en medewerkers er elke dag mee werken, wordt technologie waardevol. Zeker in finance, waar betrouwbaarheid, controleerbaarheid en regelgeving nooit bijzaak zijn. Als Senior Forward Deployed AI Engineer ben je erbij vanaf het eerste gesprek. Je brengt "we willen iets met AI" binnen weken terug tot een use case die je kunt testen, of je zegt eerlijk dat het (nog) niet kan. Daarna ontwerp en bouw je de oplossing en breng je hem live in cycli van dagen. En dan maak je jezelf overbodig. Wat ga je doen? Je slaat de brug tussen business en techniek: je zit aan tafel bij de klant, ontwerpt de oplossing en implementeert vaak ook zelf. Use cases scherp krijgen: samen met business development voer je discoverygesprekken, toets je use cases aan echte data en systemen en bouw je in dagen een proof-of-value. Ontwerpen en uitvoeren: je ontwerpt de agentic architectuur, kiest per situatie het patroon dat past en brengt de oplossing in korte cycli naar productie, samen met onze AI Engineers. Overdragen en meten: de klant kan de oplossing zelf draaien, en na go-live meet je of hij echt gebruikt wordt. Dát is je maatstaf. Ons slimmer maken: wat je leert, maak je herbruikbaar voor de volgende klant, en je helpt nieuwe FDE's op weg. Ongeveer 10% van je tijd gaat naar pre-sales en 90% naar delivery; business development is commercieel eigenaar. Van KYC tot complexe financiële processen Je kent de werkelijkheid achter KYC/AML, klantacceptatie, klachten- en schadeafhandeling, financiële rapportage, risk en compliance. Denk aan: KYC-dossiers die agents voorbereiden met herleidbare bronnen, zodat analisten sneller onderbouwd beslissen. Documenten en signalen die samenkomen voor een klachten- of schadeteam. Rapportages die nu handwerk zijn, geautomatiseerd binnen de kaders van DORA en de EU AI Act. Wat breng je mee? Aantoonbare ervaring in finance: je kent de processen, data, systemen en risico's van binnenuit. Je hebt AI-oplossingen met LLM's en agents ontworpen, in productie gebracht én onderhouden, inclusief evals, guardrails, monitoring en security. Sterk in Python en SQL, en hands-on met minimaal één cloud (Azure, AWS of GCP) en een dataplatform zoals Databricks, Snowflake of Fabric. Je werkt dagelijks met coding agents en beoordeelt kritisch wat ze opleveren. Ervaring in een klantgerichte rol, zoals consultancy, pre-sales, solutions engineering of je eigen startup. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels. Mooi meegenomen: ervaring met DORA, model risk management of audit trails, en met klassieke ML zoals fraude- en risicomodellen. Wat dit níet is Geen individuele detachering. Je werkt aan projecten namens adesso, met een team achter je. Geen PoC-kerkhof. We bouwen om te gebruiken. Geen slides zonder code. Je advies komt met een werkende versie. Geen agent omdat het kan. Soms is de simpelste oplossing de beste, en dat zeg je dan. Het team Je wordt onderdeel van ons AI Engineering-team: AI engineering consultants in twee rollen. De Forward Deployed AI Engineer (FDE) is eigenaar van het klantprobleem en ontwerpt de oplossing, inclusief de agentic architectuur. De AI Engineer gaat de diepte in op bouw, data, MLOps en schaal, en denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee over de juiste aanpak. Je krijgt ruimte om je eigen werk vorm te geven, maar je bent nooit alleen verantwoordelijk voor alle specialismen. Twijfel je welke rol het best bij je past? Solliciteer dan gewoon; we kijken samen.  Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen. Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt. We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief. Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen. AI-native: wij omarmen AI, ook in ons eigen werk We geloven dat AI fundamenteel verandert hoe we software bouwen, met data werken en klanten helpen. Daarom bouwen we niet aan losse experimenten, maar aan dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die echt onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen. Dat geldt ook voor hoe we zelf werken. Met onze Agentic Delivery-aanpak en eigen tools kun je echt vliegen: Context en kennisbank: agents werken met wat er écht speelt bij de klant, en kennis en beslissingen blijven herleidbaar voor mens én agent. AgentOps en governance: zicht op wat agents doen en controle over wat ze mogen, zodat ze veilig en binnen de regels werken. adSCAILE: ons eigen framework waarmee je samen met AI-agents bouwt, geïntegreerd, veilig en traceerbaar, in cycli van twee tot vier dagen in plaats van sprints van weken. Je gebruikt deze tools dagelijks en helpt ze verder te ontwikkelen. adesso is bovendien Select Partner in het Claude Partner Network van Anthropic. En we blijven kritisch: niet alles hoeft met AI. De beste oplossing staat altijd voorop. En misschien wel het belangrijkste: de mensen Je komt terecht in een team waar vakmanschap, ondernemerschap en kennisdeling centraal staan. Je werkt met ervaren specialisten en groeit door in technische visie en in verantwoordelijkheid voor klantrelaties. We houden van collega's die nieuwsgierig zijn, kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Mensen die goed zijn in hun vak, maar ook plezier hebben in samenwerken. Je krijgt bij ons vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de vrijheid om ideeën daadwerkelijk uit te voeren. Wat krijg je van ons? €5.850–€7.150 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur; 8% vakantiegeld; Contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week; Een leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding naar keuze, bovenop je salaris; 27 vakantiedagen en 4 studiedagen; €3.600 persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget per jaar en ruimte voor certificeringen; Hybride werken met flexibele werktijden; Goede pensioenregeling; Doorgroeimogelijkheden in een specialistenspoor; Internationale kennis en ontwikkelmogelijkheden, gecombineerd met een hecht Nederlands team; Zullen we kennismaken? Je hoeft niet aan ieder technisch punt te voldoen. We zijn vooral benieuwd naar wat je hebt gebouwd, welke keuzes je hebt gemaakt en waar je naartoe wilt groeien. Een cv of LinkedIn-profiel is genoeg om het gesprek te starten. Daarna volgen een kennismaking, een technisch gesprek en een praktijkcase. Bij adesso werk je niet alleen aan de technologie van morgen. Je krijgt ook de ruimte om mee te bepalen hoe we die bouwen. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow
